descStruct.summary: 🌙(kFrame=0)と同一の実値のまま空間引きずり(A8/E6′)を有効にし、共通補正 D₀=0.006+qLock(厳密一致式 q_exact=8.2358 自動算出 — 第172便で規約採用)に較正した版 — 重力(E4)+運動引きずりの二体だけで、恒星月 27.32日と**月の近点回転(実測 約8.85年で一周)**の2観測量を同時に較正再現する(exp-kf1b/kf1c 実測)。純二体のケプラー軌道は閉じた楕円で近点回転を持たない — kFrame=1 の運動引きずりが χ=w/(D₀+w) に比例する順行歳差を作り、D₀ がその較正ノブになる(第120便の一次発見)。測地線 E12・倍精度 stateCarry はDFM 版 🪨🌘💿 と同じ規約。
descStruct.observe: 軌道の向き(近点方向)がゆっくり回る — 実際の月と同じ約8.85年(≈118公転)で一周する。歳差積算 HUD の換算レートと、ゴースト楕円(点線=初期・橙=歳差×20 増幅)で回転が数公転で見える。**HUD の積算は周回内で大きく振動する(局所では逆行にも振れる)— 1公転単位で読むと正味 +0.053 rad/公転(Δϖ比 0.999)**。恒星月は 27.33日(+0.03%)。この 8.85年は較正が使った8公転窓での値で、窓を118公転まで延ばすと 20.78年に遅くなる(歳差は定常ではない — 第135便 emAudit の実測)。機構としての同定は判別サンプル群 ⭕🧲🔆 を参照。正直な明記: 実際の近点回転の主因は太陽摂動(第三体)— 本サンプルは運動引きずりという別機構での較正一致であり、機構の同定を主張しない(観測結果カード)。**周期は定義を宣言してから合否を言う**(第249便b→第250便d の裁定 I6): 同方向1周と近点間は別量で、判定は近点間、円に近い系は近点間が観測の定義に対応しないため注記にとどめる。
descStruct.control: 本サンプルは**DFM 版**(🪨🌘💿の3本 — 実定数+サンプル別スケール指数+kFrame=1+共通補正 D₀=0.006+qLock)の 1 本。**現行の較正方針**: 観測との合(3σ)を目指すのは kF0(λ_PN=1 ∧ kFrame=0)と f=1 の本で、DFM 版は観測との大差を減らす段階にある(較正の雛形ではない —— 第286便c で文言を更新)。ワンタップ対照A/B: B側 D₀=0.1 に上げると引きずりが 1/16 になり回転がほぼ止まる(χ∝1/D₀ の用量が見える)。kFrame を 0 にすると純ケプラー(閉じた楕円)へ。スピンを 0 にしても歳差は変わらない(運動起源 — exp-kf1b §A。q は自動算出〔qLock〕で、地球スピン項の混入を除く役)。(第237便: 地球スピン 0 が qLock の対照 — 月は同期自転なので切っても公転と区別できない。スピン項の距離基準を表面高度(dragRef:"interior" — 第239便の正名。「物質に囲まれた内部は完全共動し表面から減衰する」の意で、表面が特別に強いという主張ではない。旧名 "surface" は別名)にすると月位置の核は 1.15 倍。)
descStruct.brief: 月の周期と近点回転を kF1 で照合する。部分・照合の走行は台帳に記帳・🧲 との差は重みと初速の両方。較正は保留・近点移動 +12.7%(σ なし)・σ 未接続。

failureFirst.fail: A pure two-body system (🌙, kFrame=0) can never show the Moon's apsidal precession (observed: one cycle in 8.85 years) — the ellipse stays closed. The wave-119 🌘 (D₀=0.1) gave +2.7×10⁻³ rad/orbit, 1/20 of the real rate, with a +0.05% period offset.
failureFirst.pass: Dose measurements established that the drag precession scales as χ=w/(D₀+w); a joint fit of D0pull=3.24×10⁻⁵ (with D₀=0.006 for E1′) and a −0.12% initial-speed correction calibrates BOTH the sidereal month 27.32 d (+0.04%) and the 8.85-year apsidal cycle at once (tests/exp-kf1b.mjs). Wave 122: q=5 (the correction shared with 🪨) removes the Earth-spin contamination and purifies the Δϖ ratio from 0.988 to 0.999 — one pair (D₀=0.006, q=5) satisfies BOTH 🌘 and 🪨 (exp-kf1c). The real cause is solar perturbation — DFM matches it via a different mechanism, motion dragging (honest note).

descStruct.summary: The same real values as 🌙 (kFrame=0) with frame dragging (A8/E6′) enabled and the joint correction D₀=0.006 plus qLock (auto-derived exact-agreement value q_exact=8.2358, the convention adopted in wave 172) applied — gravity (E4) plus motion dragging alone reproduce TWO observables: the 27.32-day sidereal month and the Moon's apsidal precession (observed: one cycle in ≈8.85 years) (exp-kf1b/kf1c). A pure two-body Kepler orbit is a closed ellipse with no apsidal rotation — the kFrame=1 motion drag adds a prograde precession scaling as χ=w/(D₀+w), making D₀ its calibration knob (wave-120 primary finding). Geodesic E12 and double-precision stateCarry follow the template. This is one of the three DFM BUILDS (🪨🌘💿 — real constants + per-sample scale exponents + kFrame=1 + the joint correction D₀=0.006 and qLock). CURRENT CALIBRATION POLICY: agreement with observation (3 sigma) is aimed at by the kF0 books (lambda_PN=1 and kFrame=0) and the f=1 books; the DFM build is at the stage of reducing the large gaps to observation (it is not a calibration template - wording updated in wave 286c).
descStruct.observe: The orbit's apse line slowly rotates — one cycle in about 8.85 years (≈118 orbits), as the real Moon does. The precession HUD rate and the ghost ellipses (dotted = initial, amber = precession ×20) make the rotation visible within a few orbits. The HUD accumulator oscillates strongly within each orbit (locally even retrograde) — read it per full orbit: net +0.053 rad/orbit (Δϖ ratio 0.999). The sidereal month is 27.33 d (+0.03%). This 8.85-year figure is the value IN THE 8-ORBIT WINDOW the calibration used — stretching the window to 118 orbits slows it to 20.78 years (the precession is not steady; see wave-135's mechanism audit). For mechanism identification, see the audit family ⭕🧲🔆 (emAudit). Honest note: the real cause of the lunar apsidal precession is solar perturbation (a third body) — this sample matches it via a different mechanism, motion dragging, and claims no mechanism identification (see the observation card).  Periods are judged only after their DEFINITION has been declared (adjudication I6, waves 249b→250d): the same-direction revolution and the periapsis-to-periapsis interval are different quantities; the verdict follows the periapsis definition, and where a system is near-circular that definition does not correspond to the observation, so it is annotated rather than judged.
descStruct.control: This is one of the three DFM BUILDS (🪨🌘💿 — real constants + per-sample scale exponents + kFrame=1 + the joint correction D₀=0.006 and qLock). CURRENT CALIBRATION POLICY: agreement with observation (3 sigma) is aimed at by the kF0 books (lambda_PN=1 and kFrame=0) and the f=1 books; the DFM build is at the stage of reducing the large gaps to observation (it is not a calibration template - wording updated in wave 286c). One-tap A/B: raising D₀ to 0.1 on side B cuts the drag by 1/16 and the rotation nearly stops (the χ∝1/D₀ dose made visible). Setting kFrame to 0 returns to pure Kepler (closed ellipse). Zeroing the spins changes nothing (motion origin — exp-kf1b §A).
descStruct.brief: Compare the Moon's period and apsidal rotation with kF1. Partial: the comparison runs are in the ledger; 🧲 gap: weight + speed. Calibration: hold — apsidal advance +12.7% (no σ); no σ connected.

failureFirst.fail: 第135便の機構判別で分かったこと: 本サンプルの「8.85年」は**較正に使った 8公転窓だけの値**である。同じ設定のまま窓を延ばすと近点回転は単調に遅くなり(20公転 10.10年・40公転 12.42年・118公転=約8.85年ぶんで 20.78年)、同時に離心率が 0.0549 から 0.169 まで単調に汲み上げられる。実際の月の離心率は 0.026〜0.077 に有界で、近点回転率も定常である — **この2点で本サンプルの運動引きずり機構は現実の月と区別できる**(dt を 0.016〜0.8 の 50倍幅に振っても 8公転窓は 8.858年で4桁一致・118公転窓は 20.78〜20.77年で 0.04% 一致なので、数値の問題ではない)。
failureFirst.pass: 較正窓(8公転)では 🌘 の較正どおり Δϖ=+0.05308 rad/公転=8.857年(観測 8.85年と +0.08%)・恒星月 27.331日(+0.03%)を再現する。純二体では原理的に出ない観測量が、空間引きずり(A8/E6′)+D₀=0.006+qLock だけで出る。**その一致が本物の機構同定ではないこと**を示すのが本サンプルの役目であり、それは注意書きではなく上の窓依存・離心率汲み上げという実験結果として示される。

descStruct.summary: 機構判別の**主役B**。🌘(地球と月・実単位・kFrame=1)と物理・幾何が bit 一致の二体で、空間引きずり(A8/E6′)を共通補正 D₀=0.006+qLock(q_exact=8.2358)に較正したもの。較正窓(8公転)では月の近点回転 8.85年と恒星月 27.32日を同時に再現する — しかし**それは較正一致であって機構の同定ではない**。第135便はその主張を、注意書きではなく3条件比較(⭕A 二体ニュートン / 🧲B 本サンプル / 🔆C 太陽+地球+月の三体)の実験結果として示す。
descStruct.observe: 較正窓の 8公転窓で 8.857年(Δϖ=+0.05308 rad/公転・観測 8.85年と +0.08%)、恒星月は 27.331日。**ここからが第135便の判別実測**: 同じ設定のまま測定窓を延ばすと近点回転は単調に遅くなり、20公転で 10.10年・40公転で 12.42年・118公転窓では 20.78年になる(dt を 0.016〜0.8 の 50倍幅に振っても 8公転窓は 8.858年で4桁一致・118公転窓は 0.04% 一致なので、数値の問題ではない)。同時に離心率が 0.0549 から 0.169 へ単調に汲み上げられる — 実際の月は 0.026〜0.077 に有界で、近点回転も定常である。つまり本サンプルの数値一致は**較正窓に固有の一致**であって、機構としては実際の月と区別できる。🔆C(較正ゼロの三体)は同じ観測量を窓にも dt にも依らない定常率で出す。**周期は定義を宣言してから合否を言う**(第249便b→第250便d の裁定 I6): 同方向1周と近点間は別量で、判定は近点間、円に近い系は近点間が観測の定義に対応しないため注記にとどめる。
descStruct.control: ワンタップ対照A/B: B側は kFrame=0・D₀=0.1(=⭕判別A)で、引きずりを切ると近点回転が消えて閉じた楕円へ戻る。D₀ を 0.1 に上げるだけでも引きずりは 1/16 になる(χ=w/(D₀+w) の用量)。スピンを 0 にしても歳差は変わらない(運動起源 — exp-kf1b §A)。本サンプルは 🌘 と bit 一致なので、🌘 側の説明・claims もそのまま読める(本サンプルは**判別のための再宣言**)。
descStruct.brief: 月の較正窓の一致が長期に続くかを調べる。達・長い窓で 20.77 年へずれることを検出・🌘 との差は重みと初速。較正は保留・近点移動 +23.1%(σ なし)・σ 未接続。

failureFirst.fail: What the wave-135 mechanism audit found: the "8.85 years" of this sample is the value IN THE 8-ORBIT WINDOW THE CALIBRATION USED. Keeping everything else fixed and stretching the window, the precession slows monotonically (20 orbits 10.10 yr, 40 orbits 12.42 yr, 118 orbits — one nominal 8.85-year cycle — 20.78 yr), while the eccentricity is pumped monotonically from 0.0549 to 0.169. The real Moon's eccentricity is bounded between 0.026 and 0.077 and its apsidal rate is steady: on those two counts the motion-dragging mechanism of this sample is DISTINGUISHABLE from the real Moon. Sweeping dt over a fiftyfold range (0.016–0.8) leaves the 8-orbit window at 8.858 yr to four digits and the 118-orbit window within 0.04%, so this is not a numerical issue.
failureFirst.pass: Within the calibration window (8 orbits) the sample reproduces 🌘's calibration: Δϖ=+0.05308 rad/orbit = 8.857 yr (+0.08% from the observed 8.85 yr) with a 27.331-day sidereal month (+0.03%). An observable a pure two-body system can never produce comes out of frame dragging (A8/E6′) plus D₀=0.006 and qLock alone. The sample's job is to show that this agreement is NOT a mechanism identification — and it shows it as an experimental result (the window dependence and eccentricity pumping above), not as a footnote.

descStruct.summary: The PRIMARY, condition B of the mechanism audit. A two-body system bit-identical in physics and geometry to 🌘 (Earth & Moon, real units, kFrame=1), with frame dragging (A8/E6′) calibrated by the shared correction D₀=0.006 plus qLock (q_exact=8.2358). In the calibration window (8 orbits) it reproduces BOTH the Moon's 8.85-year apsidal cycle and the 27.32-day sidereal month — but that is a CALIBRATED MATCH, not a mechanism identification. Wave 135 makes that claim an experimental result rather than a footnote, through the three-condition comparison ⭕A (Newtonian two-body) / 🧲B (this sample) / 🔆C (Sun + Earth + Moon).
descStruct.observe: In the 8-orbit calibration window: 8.857 years (Δϖ=+0.05308 rad/orbit, +0.08% from the observed 8.85 yr) with a 27.331-day sidereal month. HERE IS THE WAVE-135 AUDIT MEASUREMENT: keeping the setup fixed and stretching the measurement window, the precession slows monotonically — 10.10 yr at 20 orbits, 12.42 yr at 40 orbits, 20.78 yr at 118 orbits (sweeping dt over a fiftyfold range holds the 8-orbit value to four digits and the 118-orbit value to 0.04%, so this is not numerics). At the same time the eccentricity is pumped monotonically from 0.0549 to 0.169, while the real Moon stays bounded between 0.026 and 0.077 with a steady apsidal rate. The numerical agreement is therefore specific to the calibration window, and as a mechanism this sample is distinguishable from the real Moon. 🔆C (the uncalibrated three-body case) delivers the same observable at a steady rate independent of both window and dt.  Periods are judged only after their DEFINITION has been declared (adjudication I6, waves 249b→250d): the same-direction revolution and the periapsis-to-periapsis interval are different quantities; the verdict follows the periapsis definition, and where a system is near-circular that definition does not correspond to the observation, so it is annotated rather than judged.
descStruct.control: One-tap A/B: side B is kFrame=0, D₀=0.1 (= ⭕ Audit A) — switching dragging off makes the precession vanish and the ellipse close. Raising D₀ to 0.1 alone already cuts the drag by 1/16 (the χ=w/(D₀+w) dose). Zeroing the spins changes nothing (motion origin — exp-kf1b §A). This sample is bit-identical to 🌘, so 🌘's own description and claims apply verbatim; this is a RE-DECLARATION for the audit.
descStruct.brief: Check whether the lunar calibration-window agreement lasts. Met: detects a drift to 20.77 yr in a long window; 🌘 gap: weight+speed. Calibration: hold — apsidal advance +23.1% (no σ); no σ connected.

chain.note: 運動引きずりが作る順行歳差 χ=w/(D₀+w) を D₀ で較正して、月の近点回転(実測 約8.85年)に合わせた項目(exp-kf1b/kf1c)。**較正に使った 8公転窓での値**であることを窓ごと宣言する。
chain.noteEn: The prograde precession from motion dragging, χ=w/(D₀+w), calibrated through D₀ to the Moon's observed 8.85-year cycle (exp-kf1b/kf1c). The window (8 orbits, the one the calibration used) is declared together with the value.

claims.roleNote: fit の対象 — D₀=0.006 と初速 −0.32% の共同フィットが合わせにいった観測量そのもの。実際の月の近点回転の主因は太陽摂動(第三体)で、本サンプルは別機構での較正一致であって機構の同定ではない(🔆C が現実側の機構の対照)。
claims.roleNoteEn: Fit target — the observation the joint fit (D₀=0.006 and the −0.32% initial speed) was tuned to. The real cause is solar perturbation (a third body); this is a calibrated match through a different mechanism, not a mechanism identification (🔆C is the real-mechanism control).

chain.note: 同じ設定のまま測定窓を 8→118公転に延ばしたときの近点回転周期。定常な永年率なら窓に依らないはずで、実測 20.78年(較正窓の 2.35倍)は**歳差が定常でない**ことを意味する。🔆C は同じ延長で 8.754→8.752年(窓依存なし)。
chain.noteEn: The apsidal period measured over 118 orbits instead of 8, everything else fixed. A steady secular rate would be window-independent; the measured 20.78 yr (2.35× the calibration window) means the precession is NOT steady. Under the same extension 🔆C goes 8.754→8.752 yr (no window dependence).

claims.roleNote: 回顧的確認 — 較正後に測り直した判別量で、fit の対象ではない。3条件比較の判別力そのもの。
claims.roleNoteEn: Retrospective check — a discriminating quantity measured after the calibration, not a fit target. It is where the three-condition comparison gets its discriminating power.

chain.note: 引きずり較正下の離心率の上端(118公転)。実際の月は 0.026〜0.077 に有界だが、本構成では 0.169 まで単調に汲み上げられる — 近点回転を合わせた代償として現れる第2の判別量。
chain.noteEn: The upper end of the eccentricity over 118 orbits under the drag calibration. The real Moon stays bounded between 0.026 and 0.077; this construction pumps it monotonically to 0.169 — a second discriminant, the price paid for matching the apsidal rate.

claims.roleNote: 回顧的確認 — 較正の対象外の観測量で、実際の月と合わない側の実測。正直な明記のための計上。
claims.roleNoteEn: Retrospective check — an observable outside the calibration that does NOT match the real Moon. Counted here for honesty.

descStruct.summary: ☄️(kFrame=0)と同一の実値のまま空間引きずり(A8/E6′)を有効にし、**共通補正 D₀=0.006+qLock(q_exact=6.1471 自動算出)**を入れた版(第122便→第123便 qLock 化→第172便 q_exact 規約。当時の表現「kF1 のまま 43″/世紀を成立」の 43″/世紀は、別系〔a=150・ε=2〕で λ_PN=1 と 0 の差を RL 勾配・600 公転で取った値 —— 第280便a)。逆行歳差の正体は pinned 太陽の実自転(25.05日)が作る**スピン項 ω(d)=s·(R/(R+d))^q** — q=3 では −7.3×10⁻⁵ rad/公転(−1.5万″/世紀)と3桁不一致だったが、qLock の厳密一致式(遠方近似形に有限半径補正 3·ln(a/(R+a))/ln((R+a)/R) を加えた形)が返す 6.1471 の幾何減衰で −4.9×10⁻¹⁰(LT級・1PN の約1/1000 —— kF1−kF0 の差)まで消える。D₀=0.006 は 🌘💿 と共通・q は同一式の自動算出 — 「同じ値」ではなく**同じ算出則**が全系を満たす(exp-kf1c/kf1d)。重力は E4・測地線は E12。**DFM 版**(🪨🌘💿の3本 — 実定数+サンプル別スケール指数+kFrame=1+共通補正 D₀=0.006+qLock)の 1 本。**現行の較正方針**: 観測との合(3σ)を目指すのは kF0(λ_PN=1 ∧ kFrame=0)と f=1 の本で、DFM 版は観測との大差を減らす段階にある(較正の雛形ではない —— 第286便c で文言を更新)。
descStruct.observe: 歳差積算 HUD が ☄️ と同水準(+43″/世紀級)を示す — 判定器の近点通過(59 近点)では kF1−kF0 が −2.856×10⁻⁸ deg/周で、ε・刻みを変えても ☄️ と同じだけ不足する(太陽の自転 0 ならビット一致 —— 第280便a)。q を 3 へ下げると大きな逆行レートに変わり、ゴースト楕円(×10³)が逆回りする(スピン項の復活が一目で見える)。スピンを 0 にすると q=3 でも kF0 と厳密一致(スピン起源の分解)。
descStruct.control: 本サンプルは**DFM 版**(🪨🌘💿の3本 — 実定数+サンプル別スケール指数+kFrame=1+共通補正 D₀=0.006+qLock)の 1 本。**現行の較正方針**: 観測との合(3σ)を目指すのは kF0(λ_PN=1 ∧ kFrame=0)と f=1 の本で、DFM 版は観測との大差を減らす段階にある(較正の雛形ではない —— 第286便c で文言を更新)。q は自動算出(qLock — スライダーはグレーアウト)。太陽の spin を 0 にすると q=3 でも引きずりが消える(スピン起源)。kFrame を 0 にすると ☄️ と同一。被引きずり側(水星)のスピンは×10⁴でも歳差に無関与(自分自身は u から除外 — exp-kf1c §B)。

descStruct.summary: The same real values as ☄️ (kFrame=0) with frame dragging (A8/E6′) enabled and the joint correction D₀=0.006 plus qLock (auto-derived q_exact=6.1471) applied (wave 122 → qLock in wave 123 → the q_exact convention in wave 172; the then-wording "43″/century holds with kF1" refers to a λ_PN=1 minus 0 RL-gradient value over 600 orbits on a separate system a=150/ε=2 — wave 280a). The retrograde precession was the SPIN term ω(d)=s·(R/(R+d))^q of the pinned Sun's real rotation (25.05 d): at q=3 it gave −7.3×10⁻⁵ rad/orbit (3 orders off), while the exact-agreement qLock value 6.1471 (the distant-limit form plus the finite-radius correction 3·ln(a/(R+a))/ln((R+a)/R)) cuts it to −4.9×10⁻¹⁰ (LT-class, about 1/860 of 1PN — the kF1−kF0 difference). D₀=0.006 is shared with 🌘💿 and q is auto-derived from the same rule — not the same VALUE but the same derivation satisfies every system (exp-kf1c/kf1d). Gravity is E4, geodesics E12. This is one of the three DFM BUILDS (🪨🌘💿 — real constants + per-sample scale exponents + kFrame=1 + the joint correction D₀=0.006 and qLock). CURRENT CALIBRATION POLICY: agreement with observation (3 sigma) is aimed at by the kF0 books (lambda_PN=1 and kFrame=0) and the f=1 books; the DFM build is at the stage of reducing the large gaps to observation (it is not a calibration template - wording updated in wave 286c).
descStruct.observe: The precession HUD sits at the ☄️ level (+43″/century class) — with the judge's periapsis crossing (59 periapses) kF1−kF0 is −2.856×10⁻⁸ deg/orbit, and changing ε or the step leaves the same shortfall as ☄️ (bit-identical to kF0 with the Sun's spin 0 — wave 280a). Lower q to 3 and it flips to a large retrograde rate with the ghost ellipse (×10³) rotating backwards (the spin term coming back, visibly). Zero the spin and even q=3 matches kF0 exactly (spin-origin decomposition).

failureFirst.fail: share 重み(w=m/√(d²+ε²))期の ✴️ は、kFrame=1 で観測周期を再現するために質量を 1.84 倍する較正を必要とし、その較正が E6′-R 偶力の飽和(±40 クランプ)を招いて第205〜208便の隠れコア受け皿を要した。**第242便の pull 重み(w=m/(d²+ε²)・D₀ᵖ=0.324204 単位)ではこの構造が丸ごと落ちる**: χ が 10⁻⁴ 級になり **較正質量という主題自体が消え**、二層(隠れコア)も宣言できない((f−1)/f が core.massFrac の値域下限 0.01 を割る)。**第245便(裁定 A6)で台帳は一次則 f=1+k_F(αχ_A+βχ_B) へ切り替えた** — χ² 則の f=1.0000000 に対し一次則は f=1.0002158 で、質量は観測値の +0.022% にとどまる(χ≪1 では χ² 則が χ の2乗ぶん過小に見積もる)。2周目 P は観測を −0.62% 外す(hold-out)。この残差と +0.89°/周 のロゼットは fit で消さずそのまま宣言する。
failureFirst.pass: **「質量は軌道から計算式で算出される量 — 計算式が変われば質量が変わる」(原仮定者・2026-08-25 第8報)の pull 重み版**。解析慣性則(第245便の台帳は一次則 f=1+k_F(αχ_A+βχ_B)・α=m_A/M・β=m_B/M・χ_i=局所場分率の自己無撞着解)を pull 重みで解くと f=1.0002158 で、**DFM 質量は観測質量の +0.022%** にとどまる(第240便の χ² 則なら f=1.0000000 — 併記して A-B 対照を残す)。フィットしたノブは無い(D₀=0.006・q=4.6111 は ✨ からの流用・D₀ᵖ=0.324204 は 3.24204×10⁸ kg/m² の単位換算)。この状態で 2周目 P −0.62%・実測離心率 +0.20%・近点 −0.29% — **すべて hold-out** として宣言する。偶力は coupleSink=reservoir でリザーバ帳簿へ記帳し、殻スピン(=観測自転)は全窓ビット保持・clampSN=0・帳簿 L 残差 6.8×10⁻¹⁵(機械ゼロ)。

descStruct.summary: **第282便a(原仮定者の裁定(第72報)③ — 「f≈1 も f=1 に」)で質量補正を廃した: f_A=1.0・f_B=1.0(massCalibration は law:"f-fixed-1")。質量は観測解の転写値そのもの(A 1.0788 M☉・B 0.9092 M☉)で、初速・位置は入力軌道のまま**(質量比は不変なので重心配分も不変)。以下の「+0.022%」「f_A=1.0002158」は**旧一次則台帳(第245便〜第281便)の記録**である(旧台帳の表は docs/PHYSICS.md〔第282便a〕)。移行後の実測は「観察」の先頭に書く。**まず見えるもの: 楕円軌道そのものがゆっくり回り続ける(ロゼット模様)— 近点移動 +0.89°/周(順行)。これは故障ではなく kFrame=1 の空間引きずり項自身の帰結である**(ニュートン重力だけなら楕円は回らない。一般相対論の 1PN 歳差 2.3×10⁻⁶ °/周は6桁小さい)。観測版 ✨(kFrame=0 — 観測安定則)の**対になる DFM 版**。転写幾何は ✨ と同一 — 遠点分離 529.61 単位(=a(1+e)・Akeson et al. 2021 の a=23.299 AU・e=0.51947)・遠点接線速度は転写質量での実ケプラー値・両星の自転と半径も転写値。**第242便(pull 重みへの移行)**: フレーム重みが w=m/(d²+ε²)(D₀ᵖ=3.24204×10⁸ kg/m²=0.324204 単位)になり、**第245便(裁定 A6 — 外部レビュー v3 三者合意)で質量台帳は一次則へ切り替えた**: f=1+k_F(αχ_A+βχ_B)(α=m_A/M・β=m_B/M・χ_A は B が A に作る局所場分率)の自己無撞着解は **f_A=1.0002158・f_B=1.0002158**(χ_A=1.99×10⁻⁴・χ_B=2.36×10⁻⁴ — 広い連星では局所場分率が 10⁻⁴ 級)。第240便の χ² 則 f=1+k_F·Σ(m_i/M)χ_i² は f=1.0000000 を返す — **χ≪1 では χ の一次か二次かで f−1 の桁が違う**(2.158×10⁻⁴ 対 4.7×10⁻⁸)ので、χ² 則の値は台帳に factorQuad として併記して A-B 対照を残す。**フィットしたノブは無い**。したがって**質量は観測値の +0.022%**(A 1.0790 M☉・B 0.9094 M☉・f−1=2.158×10⁻⁴)で、share 重み期の1.84倍較正(f=1.84419・第240便)は消えたままである。「質量は軌道から計算式で算出される量なので、計算式が変われば質量も変わる」(原仮定者第8報)の帰結が、ここでは**較正が要らない**という形で出た。**実在の質量の主張ではない**(計算式に条件づけられた較正値)。**隠れコアは持たない(第242便)**: (f−1)/f=2.157×10⁻⁴ は core.massFrac の値域下限 0.01 を割るため二層を撤去し、E6′-R と 1PN 反作用偶力は **coupleSink=reservoir** でリザーバ帳簿へ直接記帳する(📻 と同じ型 — 測地線1PN の反作用偶力〔第69便 §18.4〕も同じ受け先)。外殻(body.radius・body.spin)は**転写の光学半径・光学自転そのもの**で、実行時も全窓ビット保持。働いているのは重力(E4)と空間引きずり(A8/E6′)+測地線1PN(E12)。q=4.6111・D₀=0.006 は ✨ の値をそのまま流用。**重心ゲージ cmGauge:barycentric** は D₀ 開放系の共通加速度だけを除き相対キックは残す(較正ノブではない)。share 期の「ロゼットと f≈2 は同じ飽和した並進チャネルの二つの顔」という記述は **pull で反証された** — f は 1.0002 へ落ちるのにロゼットは +0.89°/周 で残る(したがって qTrans 掃引も pull では意味を持たない)。
descStruct.observe: **第282便a の f=1 移行後の実測**(同じ2.2公転窓・QA behavior.alphaCenAB): **2周目 79.286 年 — 観測 79.762 年の −0.60%**・1周目の**実測離心率 0.52040**・**近点移動 +0.893°/周**。判定器(calaudit の h/4 段)では同方向1周 −0.597%(25.0σ)・近点間 +0.068%・近点移動 +0.889°/周で、判定は保留(数値未解決・写像未確定)のまま動かない。以下は移行前(旧一次則台帳)の記録 —— 実測(2.2公転窓・重心ゲージ込み・pull 重み・第245便の一次則台帳): **2周目 79.269 年 — 観測 79.762 年の −0.62%**(フィットしていない hold-out 残差。χ² 則台帳では −0.60%・share 重み期は −0.83%)。合わせていない側: 1周目の**実測離心率 0.52051**(転写 0.51947 の +0.20%)・近点 167.01 単位(観測版の 167.49 の −0.29%)— どちらも ±1% に入る。軌道は歳差するロゼットで、**近点移動 +0.89°/周**(順行 — 近点通過方向の実測。share 重み期は +4.26°/周)。**殻スピンのドリフトは A +0.0%・B +0.0%**(2.2公転の min=max が転写値のビット値 — 観測自転 15.9日/36.23日 を実行時も保持)・**clampSN=0**(偶力は coupleSink=reservoir でリザーバ帳簿へ)・角運動量帳簿(総L+リザーバ)の相対残差 6.8×10⁻¹⁵(機械ゼロ)。重心は 2.2公転で 1.7×10⁻⁵ 単位(機械ゼロ)・粒子+リザーバの線運動量残差 6.4×10⁻¹⁴。公転の向きは ✨ と同回り(第204便)。NaN ゼロ・同一構成2回実行はビット同一(QA behavior.alphaCenAB)。**周期は定義を宣言してから合否を言う**(第249便b→第250便d の裁定 I6): 同方向1周と近点間は別量で、判定は近点間、円に近い系は近点間が観測の定義に対応しないため注記にとどめる。
descStruct.control: ワンタップ対照A/B: B側 kFrame=0(観測版の計算式側)— pull では質量が観測値そのものなので、B 側は観測版 ✨ とまったく同じ軌道になる(質量較正が要らないことの直接対照)。否定対照①(QA が機械固定): **coupleSink を外すと殻スピンのビット保持が壊れ**、A の自転が転写値 4.5737 から 8.43(+84%)まで歩く(0.3公転)— 保持の駆動因は受け先の宣言であることの直接証明。否定対照②(QA が機械固定): **cmGauge を外すと重心が歩き出す**(0.5公転で 0.0040 単位 = ゲージありの約240倍)。観測版 ✨ と本サンプルの対で「同じ観測・違う計算式・pull では同じ質量」が見える。timeScale=1000 で画面1秒≈11.6 日・dispMag=300(表示専用 — ✨ と同じ規約)・トレイルで軌道を見る。(第237便: 粒子別 dragQ を宣言 — A 4.6111/B 4.5259。dragQ は観測殻質量から導く量なので f に依らない。)
descStruct.brief: 観測質量のまま kF1 を α Cen へ当てる。部分・照合の走行は台帳に記帳。較正は保留・周期 −0.597%(25.1σ)・数値未解決・写像未確定。

failureFirst.fail: In the share-weight era (w=m/√(d²+ε²)) this build needed a 1.84x mass calibration to reproduce the observed period under kFrame=1, and that calibration drove the E6′-R couple into the ±40 spin saturation, which in turn required the hidden-core receptacle of waves 205–208. THE WAVE-242 PULL WEIGHT (w=m/(d²+ε²), D₀ᵖ=0.324204 units) REMOVES THAT WHOLE STRUCTURE: χ falls to ~1e-4, so the subject of this sample — a mass calibration — disappears, and the two-layer declaration cannot be made either ((f−1)/f is below the core.massFrac floor of 0.01). WAVE 245 (ADJUDICATION A6) SWITCHED THE LEDGER TO THE LINEAR LAW f=1+k_F(αχ_A+βχ_B): where the χ² law gives f=1.0000000, the linear law gives f=1.0002158, so the masses sit +0.022% above the observed ones (for χ≪1 the χ² law underestimates by one power of χ). The 2nd revolution misses the observed period by −0.62% (a hold-out). That residual and the +0.89°/rev rosette are declared as they are, never fitted away.
failureFirst.pass: THE PULL-WEIGHT VERSION of the adjudicator s principle (8th device report, 2026-08-25): masses are quantities COMPUTED FROM ORBITS BY A FORMULA — change the formula and the masses change. Solving the analytic inertia law under the pull weight — wave 245 takes the LINEAR law f=1+k_F(αχ_A+βχ_B), α=m_A/M, β=m_B/M, χ_i the self-consistent local field fraction — gives f=1.0002158, so THE DFM MASSES SIT +0.022% ABOVE THE OBSERVED ONES (the χ² law would give 1.0000000; it is recorded beside the ledger). There is no fitted knob (D₀=0.006 and q=4.6111 are reused from ✨; D₀ᵖ=0.324204 is the unit conversion of 3.24204e8 kg/m²). At that state the 2nd revolution is −0.62%, the measured eccentricity +0.20% and the perihelion −0.29% — ALL hold-outs. The couples are booked into the reservoir ledger by coupleSink:reservoir, so the shell spins (= the observed rotations) are bit-held over the whole window, clampSN=0, ledger L residual 6.8e-15.

descStruct.summary: WAVE 282a (the adjudicator's ruling, 72nd report ③ — "f≈1 becomes f=1"): THE MASS CORRECTION IS WITHDRAWN — f_A=1.0, f_B=1.0 (massCalibration law:"f-fixed-1"); the masses are the transcribed observed-solution values (A 1.0788 M☉, B 0.9092 M☉) and the initial positions and velocities are the input orbit unchanged (the mass ratio is unchanged, so is the barycentric split). The +0.022% and f_A=1.0002158 below are the RECORD OF THE OLD LINEAR-LAW LEDGER (waves 245–281; the old-ledger table is in docs/PHYSICS.md). The post-migration measurements open the Observe section. WHAT YOU SEE FIRST: the ellipse itself keeps slowly rotating (a rosette pattern) — a PERIHELION ADVANCE OF +0.89°/rev (prograde), the consequence of the kFrame=1 dragging term itself (the analytic 1PN advance is six orders smaller). The DFM COUNTERPART of the observation build ✨ (kFrame=0 under the observation-stability rule). The transcribed geometry is identical to ✨: apoapsis separation 529.61 units (=a(1+e), from Akeson et al. 2021 a=23.299 AU, e=0.51947), the real Kepler apoapsis speed at the transcribed masses, and both stars rotations and radii. WAVE 242 (THE PULL MIGRATION): the frame weight is now w=m/(d²+ε²) with D₀ᵖ=3.24204e8 kg/m² = 0.324204 units. WAVE 245 (ADJUDICATION A6, agreed by all three external reviews) MOVED THE MASS LEDGER TO THE LINEAR LAW f=1+k_F(αχ_A+βχ_B) (α=m_A/M, β=m_B/M, χ_A the local field fraction B raises at A), whose self-consistent solution is f_A=1.0002158, f_B=1.0002158 (χ_A=1.99e-4, χ_B=2.36e-4 — at this separation the local field fraction is of order 1e-4). The wave-240 χ² law f=1+k_F·Σ(m_i/M)χ_i² returns 1.0000000: FOR χ≪1 THE TWO LAWS DIFFER IN THE ORDER OF f−1 (2.158e-4 vs 4.7e-8), so the χ² value is kept beside the ledger as factorQuad for the A-B comparison. THERE IS NO FITTED KNOB, and the masses are the observed ones +0.022% (A 1.0790 M☉, B 0.9094 M☉, f−1=2.158e-4); the share-era 1.84x calibration (f=1.84419, wave 240) stays gone. Masses are quantities computed from orbits by a formula — here the consequence arrives as no calibration being needed. Still NOT a real-mass claim (a value conditioned on the formula). NO HIDDEN CORE (wave 242): (f−1)/f=2.157e-4 falls below the core.massFrac floor of 0.01, so the two-layer declaration is withdrawn and the E6′-R and 1PN reaction couples are booked straight into the reservoir ledger by coupleSink:reservoir (the 📻 pattern). The shell (body.radius, body.spin) IS the transcribed optical radius and rotation, bit-held at runtime. Gravity (E4), frame dragging (A8/E6′) and the geodesic 1PN term (E12) act; q=4.6111 and D₀=0.006 are reused from ✨. cmGauge:barycentric removes only the common-mode acceleration of the D₀ open system (not a calibration knob). The share-era claim that the rosette and f≈2 were two faces of one saturated translation channel is FALSIFIED by the pull weight: f drops to 1.0002 while the rosette stays at +0.89°/rev, so under pull the qTrans sweep is moot as well.
descStruct.observe: AFTER THE WAVE-282a MIGRATION TO f=1 (same 2.2-orbit window, QA behavior.alphaCenAB): the 2nd revolution is 79.286 yr (-0.60% of the observed 79.762 yr), the 1st-revolution eccentricity 0.52040, the perihelion advance +0.893°/rev. The calibration auditor (h/4 stage) gives same-direction -0.597% (25.0σ), periapsis-to-periapsis +0.068%, precession +0.889°/rev — the verdict stays on hold (numerics unresolved, mapping unresolved). What follows is the pre-migration record: Measured over a 2.2-orbit window (barycentric gauge, pull weight, the wave-245 linear ledger): the 2nd revolution is 79.269 yr — 0.62% short of the observed 79.762 yr, a hold-out residual (nothing was fitted; the χ² ledger gave −0.60%, the share era −0.83%). The unfitted shape: 1st-revolution eccentricity 0.52051 (+0.20% of the transcribed 0.51947) and perihelion 167.01 units (−0.29% of the observation build s 167.49) — both inside ±1%. The orbit is a precessing rosette at +0.89°/rev prograde (share era: +4.26°/rev). SHELL-SPIN DRIFT A +0.0% / B +0.0% (min=max at the transcribed bit value — the observed rotations 15.9 d / 36.23 d held at runtime), clampSN=0, angular-momentum ledger (total L + reservoir) 6.8e-15, barycentre 1.7e-5 units over 2.2 orbits, particle+reservoir momentum residual 6.4e-14. The orbit runs the same way round as ✨. Zero NaN; two runs are bit-identical (QA behavior.alphaCenAB). Periods are judged only after their DEFINITION has been declared (adjudication I6, waves 249b→250d): the same-direction revolution and the periapsis-to-periapsis interval are different quantities; the verdict follows the periapsis definition, and where a system is near-circular that definition does not correspond to the observation, so it is annotated rather than judged.
descStruct.control: One-tap A/B: side B is kFrame=0 — under pull the masses are the observed ones, so side B is exactly the observation build ✨ (the direct control for no calibration being needed). Negative control 1 (machine-fixed by QA): removing coupleSink breaks the bit-hold and A s shell spin walks from 4.5737 to 8.43 (+84%) within 0.3 orbit — the hold comes from the sink declaration. Negative control 2 (machine-fixed by QA): removing cmGauge sets the barycentre walking (0.0040 units in half an orbit, ~240x the gauged value). With timeScale=1000 one on-screen second ≈ 11.6 days; dispMag=300 (display only, same as ✨); use trails. Wave 237: per-body dragQ is declared (A 4.6111 / B 4.5259) and is derived from the observed shell mass, so it does not depend on f.
descStruct.brief: Apply kF1 to α Cen with the observed masses. Partial: the comparison runs are in the ledger. Calibration: hold — period −0.597% (25.1σ); numerics unresolved; mapping unresolved.

en.description: WAVE 282a (the adjudicator's ruling, 72nd report ③ — "f≈1 becomes f=1"): THE MASS CORRECTION IS WITHDRAWN — f_A=1.0, f_B=1.0 (massCalibration law:"f-fixed-1"); the masses are the transcribed observed-solution values (A 1.0788 M☉, B 0.9092 M☉) and the initial positions and velocities are the input orbit unchanged (the mass ratio is unchanged, so is the barycentric split). The +0.022% and f_A=1.0002158 below are the RECORD OF THE OLD LINEAR-LAW LEDGER (waves 245–281; the old-ledger table is in docs/PHYSICS.md). The post-migration measurements open the Observe section. WHAT YOU SEE FIRST: the ellipse itself keeps slowly rotating (a rosette pattern) — a PERIHELION ADVANCE OF +0.89°/rev (prograde), the consequence of the kFrame=1 dragging term itself (the analytic 1PN advance is six orders smaller). The DFM COUNTERPART of the observation build ✨ (kFrame=0 under the observation-stability rule). The transcribed geometry is identical to ✨: apoapsis separation 529.61 units (=a(1+e), from Akeson et al. 2021 a=23.299 AU, e=0.51947), the real Kepler apoapsis speed at the transcribed masses, and both stars rotations and radii. WAVE 242 (THE PULL MIGRATION): the frame weight is now w=m/(d²+ε²) with D₀ᵖ=3.24204e8 kg/m² = 0.324204 units. WAVE 245 (ADJUDICATION A6, agreed by all three external reviews) MOVED THE MASS LEDGER TO THE LINEAR LAW f=1+k_F(αχ_A+βχ_B) (α=m_A/M, β=m_B/M, χ_A the local field fraction B raises at A), whose self-consistent solution is f_A=1.0002158, f_B=1.0002158 (χ_A=1.99e-4, χ_B=2.36e-4 — at this separation the local field fraction is of order 1e-4). The wave-240 χ² law f=1+k_F·Σ(m_i/M)χ_i² returns 1.0000000: FOR χ≪1 THE TWO LAWS DIFFER IN THE ORDER OF f−1 (2.158e-4 vs 4.7e-8), so the χ² value is kept beside the ledger as factorQuad for the A-B comparison. THERE IS NO FITTED KNOB, and the masses are the observed ones +0.022% (A 1.0790 M☉, B 0.9094 M☉, f−1=2.158e-4); the share-era 1.84x calibration (f=1.84419, wave 240) stays gone. Masses are quantities computed from orbits by a formula — here the consequence arrives as no calibration being needed. Still NOT a real-mass claim (a value conditioned on the formula). NO HIDDEN CORE (wave 242): (f−1)/f=2.157e-4 falls below the core.massFrac floor of 0.01, so the two-layer declaration is withdrawn and the E6′-R and 1PN reaction couples are booked straight into the reservoir ledger by coupleSink:reservoir (the 📻 pattern). The shell (body.radius, body.spin) IS the transcribed optical radius and rotation, bit-held at runtime. Gravity (E4), frame dragging (A8/E6′) and the geodesic 1PN term (E12) act; q=4.6111 and D₀=0.006 are reused from ✨. cmGauge:barycentric removes only the common-mode acceleration of the D₀ open system (not a calibration knob). The share-era claim that the rosette and f≈2 were two faces of one saturated translation channel is FALSIFIED by the pull weight: f drops to 1.0002 while the rosette stays at +0.89°/rev, so under pull the qTrans sweep is moot as well.AFTER THE WAVE-282a MIGRATION TO f=1 (same 2.2-orbit window, QA behavior.alphaCenAB): the 2nd revolution is 79.286 yr (-0.60% of the observed 79.762 yr), the 1st-revolution eccentricity 0.52040, the perihelion advance +0.893°/rev. The calibration auditor (h/4 stage) gives same-direction -0.597% (25.0σ), periapsis-to-periapsis +0.068%, precession +0.889°/rev — the verdict stays on hold (numerics unresolved, mapping unresolved). What follows is the pre-migration record: Measured over a 2.2-orbit window (barycentric gauge, pull weight, the wave-245 linear ledger): the 2nd revolution is 79.269 yr — 0.62% short of the observed 79.762 yr, a hold-out residual (nothing was fitted; the χ² ledger gave −0.60%, the share era −0.83%). The unfitted shape: 1st-revolution eccentricity 0.52051 (+0.20% of the transcribed 0.51947) and perihelion 167.01 units (−0.29% of the observation build s 167.49) — both inside ±1%. The orbit is a precessing rosette at +0.89°/rev prograde (share era: +4.26°/rev). SHELL-SPIN DRIFT A +0.0% / B +0.0% (min=max at the transcribed bit value — the observed rotations 15.9 d / 36.23 d held at runtime), clampSN=0, angular-momentum ledger (total L + reservoir) 6.8e-15, barycentre 1.7e-5 units over 2.2 orbits, particle+reservoir momentum residual 6.4e-14. The orbit runs the same way round as ✨. Zero NaN; two runs are bit-identical (QA behavior.alphaCenAB). Periods are judged only after their DEFINITION has been declared (adjudication I6, waves 249b→250d): the same-direction revolution and the periapsis-to-periapsis interval are different quantities; the verdict follows the periapsis definition, and where a system is near-circular that definition does not correspond to the observation, so it is annotated rather than judged.One-tap A/B: side B is kFrame=0 — under pull the masses are the observed ones, so side B is exactly the observation build ✨ (the direct control for no calibration being needed). Negative control 1 (machine-fixed by QA): removing coupleSink breaks the bit-hold and A s shell spin walks from 4.5737 to 8.43 (+84%) within 0.3 orbit — the hold comes from the sink declaration. Negative control 2 (machine-fixed by QA): removing cmGauge sets the barycentre walking (0.0040 units in half an orbit, ~240x the gauged value). With timeScale=1000 one on-screen second ≈ 11.6 days; dispMag=300 (display only, same as ✨); use trails. Wave 237: per-body dragQ is declared (A 4.6111 / B 4.5259) and is derived from the observed shell mass, so it does not depend on f.

chain.note: 第211便(原仮定者の実機確認質問「系全体の回転は近点移動で正しいのか」への機械回答)の pull 重み版: ✴️ のロゼット歳差は近点移動 +0.89°/周(順行・第245便の一次則台帳で 0.886)で、share 重み期の +4.26°/周 から 1/5 に減ったが**消えてはいない**。質量係数が 1.844→1.0002 と落ちたのにロゼットが残ることは、share 期の「ロゼットと f≈2 は同じ飽和した並進チャネルの二つの顔」という記述の反証である。1PN(解析値 2.3×10⁻⁶ °/周)ではなく kF1 空間引きずり項自身の帰結。QA は遠点発2.2公転窓の近点通過方向から実測する。
chain.noteEn: The pull-weight version of wave 211 (the machine answer to the adjudicator s device question — is the whole-system rotation correct as perihelion advance?): the rosette precession is +0.89°/rev prograde — a fifth of the share-era +4.26°/rev, but it DID NOT VANISH. That the rosette survives while the mass factor collapses from 1.844 to 1.0002 falsifies the share-era statement that the rosette and f≈2 were two faces of one saturated channel. It is the kF1 dragging term itself, not the 1PN term (analytic 2.3e-6 °/rev). QA measures it from the perihelion-passage directions over the 2.2-orbit window from aphelion.

failureFirst.fail: In the share-weight era this build needed a 1.888x mass calibration to reproduce the observed period under kFrame=1, and that calibration drove the E6′-R couple into the ±40 spin saturation, which required the hidden-core receptacle of wave 221. THE WAVE-242 PULL WEIGHT (w=m/(d²+ε²), D₀ᵖ=0.324204 units) REMOVES THAT STRUCTURE: χ falls to ~1e-4 (χ_A=2.82e-4, χ_B=5.70e-4), so the mass calibration disappears, and (f−1)/f falls below the core.massFrac floor of 0.01 so the two-layer declaration cannot be made either. WAVE 245 (ADJUDICATION A6) SWITCHED THE LEDGER TO THE LINEAR LAW f=1+k_F(αχ_A+βχ_B): the χ² law gives f=1.0000002, the linear law f=1.0003769, so the masses sit +0.038% above the observed ones. The 2nd revolution misses the observed period by −1.80% (a hold-out — the largest residual of the four binaries). That residual and the +2.20°/rev rosette are declared as they are, never fitted away.
failureFirst.pass: THE PULL-WEIGHT VERSION of the adjudicator's principle (8th report): masses are quantities COMPUTED FROM ORBITS BY A FORMULA — change the formula and the masses change. Solving the analytic inertia law under the pull weight — wave 245 takes the LINEAR law f=1+k_F(αχ_A+βχ_B) — gives f=1.0003769, so THE DFM MASSES SIT +0.038% ABOVE THE OBSERVED ONES (A 2.0638 M☉, B 1.0184 M☉; the χ² law would give 1.0000002, recorded beside the ledger). There is no fitted knob (D₀=0.006 and q=4.6761 are reused from 🌟; D₀ᵖ=0.324204 is the unit conversion of 3.24204e8 kg/m²). At that state the 2nd revolution is −1.80%, the measured eccentricity +0.40% and the perihelion −0.72% — ALL hold-outs. The couples are booked into the reservoir ledger by coupleSink:reservoir, so A's declared vsini/R proxy spin 13.6605 and B's spin=0 are bit-held over the whole window, clampSN=0, ledger L residual 2.9e-14.

descStruct.summary: WAVE 282a (the adjudicator's ruling, 72nd report ③ — "f≈1 becomes f=1"): THE MASS CORRECTION IS WITHDRAWN — f_A=1.0, f_B=1.0 (massCalibration law:"f-fixed-1"); the masses are the transcribed observed-solution values (A 2.0630 M☉, B 1.0180 M☉) and the initial positions and velocities are the input orbit unchanged (the mass ratio is unchanged, so is the barycentric split). The +0.038% and f_A=1.0003769 below are the RECORD OF THE OLD LINEAR-LAW LEDGER (waves 245–281; the old-ledger table is in docs/PHYSICS.md). The post-migration measurements open the Observe section. WHAT YOU SEE FIRST: the ellipse itself keeps slowly rotating (a rosette pattern) — a PERIHELION ADVANCE OF +2.20°/rev (prograde), the consequence of the kFrame=1 dragging term itself. The DFM COUNTERPART of the observation build 🌟 (kFrame=0 under the observation-stability rule). The transcribed geometry is identical to 🌟: apoapsis separation 470.98 units (=a(1+e), Bond et al. 2017 a=19.7828 AU, e=0.59142), the real Kepler apoapsis speed and both radii (Sirius B raised to the 0.01 floor by declaration). WAVE 242 (THE PULL MIGRATION): the frame weight is now w=m/(d²+ε²) with D₀ᵖ=3.24204e8 kg/m² = 0.324204 units, and WAVE 245 (ADJUDICATION A6) MOVED THE MASS LEDGER TO THE LINEAR LAW f=1+k_F(αχ_A+βχ_B), whose self-consistent solution is f_A=1.0003769, f_B=1.0003769 (χ_A=2.82e-4, χ_B=5.70e-4 — at this separation the local field fraction is of order 1e-4). THERE IS NO FITTED KNOB, and the masses are the observed ones +0.038% (A 2.0638 M☉, B 1.0184 M☉); the share-era 1.888x calibration (f=1.88813, wave 240) stays gone. Masses are quantities computed from orbits by a formula — here the consequence is that no calibration is needed at all. Still NOT a real-mass claim (a value conditioned on the formula). NO HIDDEN CORE (wave 242): (f−1)/f=3.768e-4 falls below the core.massFrac floor of 0.01, so the two-layer declaration is withdrawn and the E6′-R and 1PN reaction couples are booked straight into the reservoir ledger by coupleSink:reservoir (the 📻 pattern). A shell rotation is the declared vsini/R proxy 13.6605 (sin i=1, Takeda 2020); B has no modern measurement and stays spin=0. Gravity (E4), frame dragging (A8/E6′) and the geodesic 1PN term (E12) act; q=4.6761 and D₀=0.006 are reused from 🌟. cmGauge:barycentric removes only the common-mode acceleration of the D₀ open system. The share-era claim that the rosette and f≈2 were two faces of one saturated translation channel is FALSIFIED by the pull weight: f drops to 1 while the rosette stays at +2.20°/rev.
descStruct.observe: AFTER THE WAVE-282a MIGRATION TO f=1 (same 3.2-orbit window, QA behavior.siriusAB): the 2nd revolution is 49.242 yr (-1.77% of the observed 50.1284 yr), the 1st-revolution eccentricity 0.59361, the perihelion advance +2.195°/rev. The calibration auditor (h/4 stage) gives same-direction -1.768% (205.9σ), periapsis-to-periapsis +0.116%, precession +2.190°/rev — the verdict stays on hold (numerics unresolved, mapping unresolved). What follows is the pre-migration record: Measured over a 3.2-orbit window (barycentric gauge, pull weight, the wave-245 linear ledger): the 2nd revolution is 49.225 yr — 1.80% short of the observed 50.1284 yr, a hold-out residual (nothing was fitted; the χ² ledger gave −1.77%). The unfitted shape: 1st-revolution eccentricity 0.59377 (+0.40% of the transcribed 0.59142) and perihelion 120.05 (−0.72% of the observation build s 120.92) — both inside ±1%. The orbit is a precessing rosette at +2.20°/rev prograde (share era: +2.55°/rev). A shell-spin drift +0.0% and B residual |s|max 0.0 (bit-held over the whole window), clampSN=0, angular-momentum ledger 2.9e-14, barycentre 1.1e-5 units over 3.2 orbits, particle+reservoir momentum residual 5.6e-14. Zero NaN; two runs bit-identical (QA behavior.siriusAB). Periods are judged only after their DEFINITION has been declared (adjudication I6, waves 249b→250d): the same-direction revolution and the periapsis-to-periapsis interval are different quantities; the verdict follows the periapsis definition, and where a system is near-circular that definition does not correspond to the observation, so it is annotated rather than judged.
descStruct.control: One-tap A/B: side B is kFrame=0 — under pull the masses are the observed ones, so side B is exactly the observation build 🌟 (the direct control for no calibration being needed). Negative control 1 (machine-fixed by QA): removing coupleSink breaks the bit-hold and A s shell spin walks from 13.6605 to 17.61 (+29%) within 0.3 orbit — the hold comes from the sink declaration. Negative control 2: removing cmGauge sets the barycentre walking (0.019 units in half an orbit, ~1700x the gauged value). With timeScale=300 one on-screen second ≈ 3.5 days; dispMag=300 (display only); use trails.

chain.note: 第282便a の f=1 移行後は 2周目 49.242 年(観測の −1.77%)。〔旧一次則台帳(第245便〜第281便)の記録 — 第282便a で f=1 に固定〕: pull 重みの一次則(第245便 A6)が置く質量(f_A=1.0003769・f_B=1.0003769=観測質量の +0.038%)で kFrame=1 を回したときの2周目の周回時間。観測周期 50.1284 年に対して 49.225 年(−1.80%)— フィットしたノブは無いので、これは fit 対象ではなく hold-out の残差である(share 重み期は f=1.88813 で −0.80%)。
chain.noteEn: After the wave-282a migration to f=1 the 2nd revolution is 49.242 yr (-1.77% of the observed). [the OLD linear-law ledger, waves 245–281 — wave 282a fixed f=1] The 2nd revolution under kFrame=1 at the masses the pull-weight LINEAR inertia law puts there (f_A=f_B=1.0003769, i.e. the observed masses +0.038%): 49.225 yr against the observed 50.1284 yr (−1.80%). There is no fitted knob, so this is a hold-out residual rather than a fit target (the share era had f=1.88813 and −0.80%).

claims.roleNote: hold-out 残差の宣言 — pull では較正ノブが無い(質量は解析慣性則が決める)。
claims.roleNoteEn: A declared hold-out residual — under pull there is no calibration knob (the analytic inertia law fixes the masses).

chain.note: 受け皿宣言(第242便 — coupleSink:reservoir)の機械固定: A の殻自転は vsini/R(sin i=1)の宣言つき代理値 13.6605 で、E6′-R と 1PN の反作用偶力をリザーバ帳簿へ記帳するため **A の殻自転のドリフトは +0.0%**(3.2公転で min=max のビット不変)・clampSN=0。否定対照は coupleSink を外すこと — 保持が壊れて 17.61(+29%)まで歩く。
chain.noteEn: Machine-fixes the sink declaration (wave 242 — coupleSink:reservoir): A shell spin is the declared vsini/R proxy 13.6605, and because the E6′-R and 1PN reaction couples are booked into the reservoir ledger the SHELL-SPIN DRIFT IS +0.0% (min=max, bit-invariant over 3.2 orbits) with clampSN=0. The negative control is removing coupleSink — the hold breaks and the spin walks to 17.61 (+29%).

claims.roleNote: 回顧的確認 — 代理自転が実行時も保たれることの実測(較正ノブではない)。
claims.roleNoteEn: Retrospective check — measures that the proxy rotation is held at runtime (not a calibration knob).
claims.descPattern: A の殻自転のドリフトは \+(\d+\.\d+)%

chain.note: 第282便a の f=1 移行後は離心率 0.59361・近点 120.10。〔旧一次則台帳(第245便〜第281便)の記録 — 第282便a で f=1 に固定〕: 合わせていない側の検証: 離心率 0.59377(転写 0.59142 の +0.40%)・近点 120.05(観測版 120.92 の −0.72%)— どちらもフィットしていないのに ±1% に入る。pull では質量較正の用量が +0.038% しかないので、これは「ほぼ観測質量のままの kFrame=1 が軌道形をどれだけ保つか」の実測である。
chain.noteEn: After the wave-282a migration to f=1 the eccentricity is 0.59361 and the perihelion 120.10. [the OLD linear-law ledger, waves 245–281 — wave 282a fixed f=1] The unfitted side: eccentricity 0.59377 (+0.40% of the transcribed 0.59142) and perihelion 120.05 (−0.72% of the observation build s 120.92) — both within ±1% though neither was fitted. Under pull the calibration is only +0.038%, so it is a mass calibration at all, so this measures how well kFrame=1 at the observed masses preserves the orbit shape.

claims.roleNote: 回顧的確認 — e は独立な hold-out(fit の対象ではない)。近点は遠点固定下で e から決まる整合表示。
claims.roleNoteEn: Retrospective check — e is the independent hold-out (never fitted); with the apoapsis fixed the perihelion is e s consistency image.

chain.note: **第282便a(原仮定者の裁定(第72報)③)で f=1 に固定 — f_A=f_B=1・DFM 質量=観測質量そのもの**(説明文と massCalibration 台帳〔law:"f-fixed-1"〕と bodies の m の三者で一致して宣言)。〔旧一次則台帳(第245便〜第281便)の記録 — 第282便a で f=1 に固定〕: 「質量は軌道から計算式で算出される量 — 計算式が変われば質量が変わる」(原仮定者第8報)の pull 重み版: 第245便(裁定 A6)の台帳は一次則 f=1+k_F(αχ_A+βχ_B) で、自己無撞着解は f_A=f_B=1.0003769(χ_A=2.81×10⁻⁴・χ_B=5.70×10⁻⁴)— **DFM 質量=観測質量の +0.038%**(χ² 則なら 1.0000002・factorQuad に併記)。説明文と massCalibration 台帳と bodies の m の三者で一致して宣言されていること。share 重み期の f=1.88813(第240便)は重みの取り替えで消えた。
chain.noteEn: WAVE 282a (the adjudicator's ruling, 72nd report ③) FIXED f=1 — f_A=f_B=1 and the DFM masses ARE the observed masses (declared consistently across the text, the massCalibration ledger [law:"f-fixed-1"] and the bodies m). [the OLD linear-law ledger, waves 245–281 — wave 282a fixed f=1] The pull-weight version of the adjudicator s principle (8th report): the self-consistent analytic inertia law gives f_A=f_B=1.0000001 (χ_A=2.72e-4, χ_B=5.50e-4), so THE DFM MASSES ARE THE OBSERVED MASSES. Declared consistently across the text, the massCalibration ledger and the bodies m. The share-era f=1.88813 (wave 240) vanished with the change of weight.

claims.roleNote: f=1 の宣言(第282便a — fit なし) — QA が台帳(f-fixed-1)・bodies の m・観測版の m のビット一致を照合し、旧一次則台帳の値は behavior.chi-law が dfmBinaryMassFactorLinear の再計算で履歴として検証する。
claims.roleNoteEn: The f=1 declaration (wave 282a — no fitted knob) — QA checks the ledger (f-fixed-1), the bodies m and the observation build's m bit-for-bit; the old linear-law value is verified as history by behavior.chi-law against the dfmBinaryMassFactorLinear recomputation.

chain.note: B(観測なし — spin=0 のまま)の宣言保持の機械固定: E6′-R と 1PN の反作用偶力は coupleSink:reservoir がリザーバ帳簿へ送るので、B の**残余 |s|max 0.0**(3.2公転で全窓ビット保持・clampSN=0・帳簿 L 残差 2.9×10⁻¹⁴ の機械ゼロ)。
chain.noteEn: Machine-fixes that B s declared spin=0 (no observation) is held: coupleSink:reservoir books the E6′-R and 1PN reaction couples into the reservoir ledger, so B s residual |s|max is 0.0 — bit-held over 3.2 orbits, clampSN=0, ledger L residual 2.9e-14 (machine zero).

claims.roleNote: 回顧的確認 — 観測の無い側の spin=0 宣言の帰結を実測で照合する。
claims.roleNoteEn: Retrospective check — verifies the consequence of the spin=0 declaration on the unobserved star.

chain.note: ロゼット歳差の定量: 近点移動 +2.20°/周(順行・実測)。pull 重みでも歳差は残る — share 重み期の +2.55°/周 から少し縮んだだけで、質量係数が 1.888→1.0004 と落ちたのとは無関係である(「ロゼットと f≈2 は同じ飽和チャネルの二つの顔」という share 期の記述は、これで反証された)。1PN(解析値)ではなく kF1 空間引きずり項自身の帰結。QA は遠点発3.2公転窓の近点通過方向から実測する。
chain.noteEn: The rosette precession: +2.20°/rev prograde (measured). The precession survives the pull weight — it only shrank from the share-era +2.55°/rev, while the mass factor collapsed from 1.888 to 1.000. That falsifies the share-era statement that the rosette and f≈2 are two faces of one saturated channel. It is the kF1 dragging term itself, not the 1PN term. QA measures it from the perihelion-passage directions over the 3.2-orbit window from aphelion.

claims.roleNote: 回顧的確認 — 較正ノブはゼロ。歳差は fit で消さずそのまま宣言する。

massCalibration.note: 第282便a(原仮定者の裁定(第72報)③ — f≈1 も f=1 に): 質量補正 f を廃し bodies の m を基準質量(観測解の転写値 baseMass)へ戻した。旧台帳は一次則 inertia-law-lin-v1(f=1.0003769425929947・χ² 則 1.000000160419523 を併記)で、docs/PHYSICS.md〔第282便a〕の旧台帳表に履歴として残す。初速・位置は入力軌道のまま(質量比は不変なので重心配分も不変)。隠れコアは第242便で撤去済み(移行で除くものは無い)

raw.description: **第282便a(原仮定者の裁定(第72報)③ — 「f≈1 も f=1 に」)で質量補正を廃した: f_A=1.0・f_B=1.0(massCalibration は law:"f-fixed-1")。質量は観測解の転写値そのもの(A 2.0630 M☉・B 1.0180 M☉)で、初速・位置は入力軌道のまま**(質量比は不変なので重心配分も不変)。以下の「+0.038%」「f_A=1.0003769」は**旧一次則台帳(第245便〜第281便)の記録**である(旧台帳の表は docs/PHYSICS.md〔第282便a〕)。移行後の実測は「観察」の先頭に書く。**まず見えるもの: 楕円軌道そのものがゆっくり回り続ける(ロゼット模様)— 近点移動 +2.20°/周(順行)。kFrame=1 の空間引きずり項自身の帰結である**(ニュートン重力だけなら楕円は回らない)。観測版 🌟(kFrame=0 — 観測安定則)の**対になる DFM 版**。転写幾何は 🌟 と同一 — 遠点分離 470.98 単位(=a(1+e)・Bond et al. 2017 の a=19.7828 AU・e=0.59142)・遠点接線速度は転写質量での実ケプラー値・両星の半径も転写値(Sirius B は下限 0.01 へ宣言つき引き上げ)。**第242便(pull 重みへの移行)**: フレーム重みが w=m/(d²+ε²)(D₀ᵖ=3.24204×10⁸ kg/m²=0.324204 単位)になり、**第245便(裁定 A6)で質量台帳は一次則へ切り替えた**: f=1+k_F(αχ_A+βχ_B)(α=m_A/M・β=m_B/M)の自己無撞着解は **f_A=1.0003769・f_B=1.0003769**(χ_A=2.81×10⁻⁴・χ_B=5.70×10⁻⁴ — 広い連星では局所場分率が 10⁻⁴ 級)。第240便の χ² 則 f=1+k_F·Σ(m_i/M)χ_i² は 1.0000002 を返す(factorQuad に併記 — χ≪1 では f−1 の桁が違う)。**フィットしたノブは無い**。したがって**質量は観測値の +0.038%**(A 2.0638 M☉・B 1.0184 M☉)で、share 重み期の1.888倍較正(f=1.88813・第240便)は消えたままである。**実在の質量の主張ではない**(計算式に条件づけられた較正値)。**隠れコアは持たない(第242便)**: (f−1)/f=3.768×10⁻⁴ は core.massFrac の値域下限 0.01 を割るため二層を撤去し、E6′-R と 1PN 反作用偶力は **coupleSink=reservoir** でリザーバ帳簿へ直接記帳する(📻 と同じ型 — 測地線1PN の反作用偶力〔第69便 §18.4〕も同じ受け先)。A の殻自転は観測 vsini からの宣言つき代理値 13.6605(vsini=16.3±0.1 km/s〔Takeda 2020〕を転写半径で割った ω・sin i=1 のモデル依存代理値)、B は現代的直接測定が無いため **spin=0 のまま**。働いているのは重力(E4)+空間引きずり(A8/E6′)+測地線1PN(E12)。q=4.6761・D₀=0.006 は 🌟 の値をそのまま流用。**重心ゲージ cmGauge:barycentric** で D₀ 開放系の共通成分だけを除く(較正ノブではない)。share 期の「ロゼットと f≈2 は同じ飽和した並進チャネルの二つの顔」という記述は **pull で反証された** — f は 1 へ落ちるのにロゼットは +2.20°/周 で残る。**第282便a の f=1 移行後の実測**(同じ3.2公転窓・QA behavior.siriusAB): **2周目 49.242 年 — 観測 50.1284 年の −1.77%**・1周目の**実測離心率 0.59361**・**近点移動 +2.195°/周**。判定器(calaudit の h/4 段)では同方向1周 −1.768%(205.9σ)・近点間 +0.116%・近点移動 +2.190°/周で、判定は保留(数値未解決・写像未確定)のまま動かない。以下は移行前(旧一次則台帳)の記録 —— 実測(3.2公転窓・重心ゲージ込み・pull 重み・第245便の一次則台帳): **2周目 49.225 年 — 観測 50.1284 年の −1.80%**(フィットしていない hold-out 残差。χ² 則台帳では −1.77%)。合わせていない側: 1周目の**実測離心率 0.59377**(転写 0.59142 の +0.40%)・近点 120.05 単位(観測版の 120.92 の −0.72%)— どちらも ±1% に入る。軌道は歳差するロゼットで**近点移動 +2.20°/周**(順行・遠点発窓の近点通過方向の実測。share 重み期は +2.55°/周)。**A の殻自転のドリフトは +0.0%**(3.2公転で min=max のビット不変 — 代理自転 13.6605 を実行時も保持)・B の**残余 |s|max 0.0**(全窓ビット保持)・**clampSN=0**(偶力は coupleSink=reservoir でリザーバ帳簿へ)・角運動量帳簿(総L+リザーバ)の相対残差 2.9×10⁻¹⁴(機械ゼロ)。重心は 3.2公転で 1.1×10⁻⁵ 単位(機械ゼロ)・粒子+リザーバの線運動量残差 5.6×10⁻¹⁴。NaN ゼロ・同一構成2回実行はビット同一(QA behavior.siriusAB)。**周期は定義を宣言してから合否を言う**(第249便b→第250便d の裁定 I6): 同方向1周と近点間は別量で、判定は近点間、円に近い系は近点間が観測の定義に対応しないため注記にとどめる。ワンタップ対照A/B: B側 kFrame=0(観測版の計算式側)— pull では質量が観測値そのものなので、B 側は観測版 🌟 とまったく同じ軌道になる(質量較正が要らないことの直接対照)。否定対照①(QA が機械固定): **coupleSink を外すと殻スピンのビット保持が壊れ**、A の自転が 13.6605 から 17.61(+29%)まで歩く(0.3公転)— 保持の駆動因は受け先の宣言であることの直接証明。否定対照②(QA が機械固定): **cmGauge を外すと重心が歩き出す**(0.5公転で 0.019 単位 = ゲージありの約1700倍)。timeScale=300 で画面1秒≈3.5 日・dispMag=300(表示専用)・トレイルで軌道を見る。

failureFirst.fail: **f=1(観測質量)のまま kFrame=1(空間引きずり A8/E6′+測地線 1PN E12 — DFM の計算式)で回すと、観測の軌道を保てない**: 出発点の遠点 955.98 単位が近点側になり、軌道は遠点 9853.77 単位まで膨らんで、同方向1周は観測周期 8834.534723278 秒の約 21.5 倍(1周目 190031.36 秒)になる。実測離心率は 0.82315(転写 0.087777036)。**観測周期は再現しない。** 第245〜283便はこの差を質量補正 f≈2(一次則の条件つき較正)と Kcs=0 の補正コアで埋めていたが、原仮定者の裁定(第74報)⑤で f=1 に戻した(旧台帳は履歴)。
failureFirst.pass: f=1 の宣言は機械で固定してある: bodies の m は観測基準質量(baseMass)とビット一致・補正コアは無い・λ_PN=1 は明示・偶力は coupleSink=reservoir でリザーバ帳簿へ記帳され、殻スピン(spin=0 宣言)は全窓ビット保持(clampSN=0)・帳簿 L 残差 7.8×10⁻¹⁴(2 周)で閉じる。初速・位置・dragQ は比較用に移行前のまま固定してある(**新しい走行から調整する** —— 旧較正値を転記しない)。

descStruct.summary: **第284便b(原仮定者の裁定(第74報)⑤「f=1 の修正を進める」)で質量補正を廃した: f_A=f_B=1.0(massCalibration は law:"f-fixed-1")。質量は Hu et al. (2022) の観測基準質量そのもの(A 1.3382 M☉・B 1.2489 M☉)で、Kcs=0 の補正コアを外し、偶力の受け先をリザーバにした。** 📻(kFrame=0 — 観測安定則)の対になる DFM 版で、転写幾何は 📻 と同一(遠点分離 955.98 単位・転写質量での実ケプラー遠点速度・半径は EOS proxy 0.01175)。**まず見えるもの: kFrame=1(空間引きずり A8/E6′+測地線 1PN E12)では軌道が外へ膨らみ、観測の軌道にならない** —— 出発点の遠点が近点側になり、遠点は 9853.77 単位まで離れる。初速・位置・dragQ は比較用に移行前のまま固定してあり、観測値との差を**合わせる操作はしていない**(引きずりプロファイルの再調整は今後の便で新走行から行う)。旧台帳(一次則 f≈2)の周期・近点移動・短縮率は**履歴**であって、この本の現在の根拠ではない。
descStruct.observe: 実測(QA behavior.psrF1・既定 dt=0.016・同方向1周を 2 回): **同方向1周の 1周目 190031.36 秒・2周目 189819.52 秒**(観測 8834.534723278 秒の約 21.5 倍)。1周目の**実測離心率 0.82315**・最小分離 955.86 単位・最大分離 9853.77 単位。判定器(calaudit)では、第285便f(原仮定者の裁定(第75報)AN51)で f=1 の軌道長に合わせた窓(22 公転 × 1,187,696 步)を事前に宣言し、近点間周期を 188141.17 秒(dt 段・近点 23 個・門は数値未解決)と測った —— 4 値の区分は保留のまま動かない。殻スピンのドリフト 0.0%(spin=0 の全窓ビット保持・clampSN=0)・帳簿 L 残差 7.8×10⁻¹⁴・重心移動 6.6×10⁻⁴ 単位(2 周)。リザーバが持つ角運動量は最大で初期 L の 0.60%(遠点付近)。
descStruct.control: ワンタップ対照A/B: B側 kFrame=0(観測版の計算式側)— f=1 では質量が観測値そのものなので、B 側は観測版 📻 とまったく同じ軌道になる(1周目 8835.04 秒・近点 801.72 単位)。同じ観測・同じ質量で計算式だけが違うと、kFrame=1 側は軌道を保てないことが 1 操作で見える。否定対照(QA が機械固定): **coupleSink を外すと殻が ±40 飽和へ走り出す**(0.3公転で clampSN 3.2×10⁴)・**cmGauge を外すと重心が歩き出す**(0.5公転で 0.166 単位)。timeScale=300・dispMag=1000(表示専用 — 📻 と同じ規約)・トレイルで軌道を見る。

calibrationForecast.note: At f=1 (the observed masses) and kFrame=1 the orbit swells outward from the 955.98-unit apoapsis and one same-direction revolution is about 21.5 times the observed period. The auditor measures the periastron-to-periastron period in the orbit window declared in wave 285f (AN51 — 22 revolutions, 23 periastra): 188141.17 s at dt (numerics unresolved). The old ledger's (f≈2) stage records are history and are not used as convergence material for this build.

failureFirst.fail: AT f=1 (THE OBSERVED MASSES) UNDER kFrame=1 (frame dragging A8/E6′ + the 1PN geodesic E12 — the DFM formula) THE OBSERVED ORBIT IS NOT HELD: the starting apoapsis at 955.98 units becomes the periastron side, the orbit swells to an apoapsis of 9853.77 units and one same-direction revolution is about 21.5 times the observed 8834.534723278 s (1st revolution 190031.36 s). The measured eccentricity is 0.82315 (transcribed 0.087777036). THE OBSERVED PERIOD IS NOT REPRODUCED. Waves 245–283 closed this gap with a mass correction f≈2 (the conditional linear-law calibration) and a Kcs=0 correction core; the adjudicator's ruling (74th report ⑤) returned it to f=1 (the old ledger is history).
failureFirst.pass: The f=1 declaration is machine-fixed: the bodies' m equal the observed base masses bit-for-bit, there is no correction core, λ_PN=1 is explicit, and the couples are booked into the reservoir ledger by coupleSink=reservoir, so the shell spins (spin=0 declared) stay bit-held over the whole window (clampSN=0) and the ledger L residual closes at 7.8×10⁻¹⁴ over two revolutions. The initial positions, velocities and dragQ are kept from before the migration for comparison (TO BE ADJUSTED FROM NEW RUNS — no old calibration value is carried over).

descStruct.summary: WAVE 284b (the adjudicator's ruling, 74th report ⑤ — "advance the f=1 correction") WITHDREW THE MASS CORRECTION: f_A=f_B=1.0 (massCalibration law:"f-fixed-1"). The masses are the observed base masses of Hu et al. (2022) (A 1.3382 M☉, B 1.2489 M☉); the Kcs=0 correction core is removed and the couples go to the reservoir. The DFM counterpart of 📻 (kFrame=0 — the observation-stability rule) with the same transcribed geometry (apoapsis separation 955.98 units, the real Kepler apoapsis speed at the transcribed masses, radii = EOS proxy 0.01175). WHAT YOU SEE FIRST: under kFrame=1 (frame dragging A8/E6′ + the 1PN geodesic E12) THE ORBIT SWELLS OUTWARD AND IS NOT THE OBSERVED ONE — the starting apoapsis becomes the periastron side and the apoapsis moves out to 9853.77 units. The initial positions, velocities and dragQ are kept from before the migration for comparison, and NOTHING HAS BEEN ADJUSTED to close the gap to the observations (re-tuning the drag profile is left to a later wave, from new runs). The old ledger's (linear law, f≈2) period, apsidal advance and contraction rate are HISTORY, not a current basis for this build.
descStruct.observe: Measured (QA behavior.psrF1, default dt=0.016, two same-direction revolutions): THE 1st SAME-DIRECTION REVOLUTION IS 190031.36 s AND THE 2nd 189819.52 s (about 21.5 times the observed 8834.534723278 s). The 1st-revolution MEASURED ECCENTRICITY IS 0.82315, minimum separation 955.86 units, maximum 9853.77 units. In the auditor (calaudit), wave 285f (the adjudicator's ruling, 75th report AN51) declared in advance a window matched to the f=1 orbit length (22 revolutions × 1,187,696 steps), and the periastron-to-periastron period is 188141.17 s (dt stage, 23 periastra, gate: numerics unresolved) — the four-value class stays on hold. Shell-spin drift 0.0% (spin=0 bit-held over the whole window, clampSN=0), ledger L residual 7.8×10⁻¹⁴, barycentre shift 6.6×10⁻⁴ units (two revolutions). The reservoir holds at most 0.60% of the initial L (near apoapsis).
descStruct.control: One-tap A/B: side B is kFrame=0 (the observation build's formula) — at f=1 the masses are the observed ones, so side B is exactly the observation build 📻 (1st revolution 8835.04 s, periastron 801.72 units). With the same observations and the same masses, only the formula differs, and the kFrame=1 side cannot hold the orbit — visible in one tap. Negative controls (machine-fixed by QA): REMOVING coupleSink sets the shells running to the ±40 saturation (clampSN 3.2×10⁴ in 0.3 orbit); REMOVING cmGauge sets the barycentre walking (0.166 units in half an orbit). timeScale=300, dispMag=1000 (display only, same as 📻); use trails.
descStruct.brief: Compare the double pulsar with the observed masses (f=1) under kF1. Partial: the comparison runs are in the ledger. Calibration: hold — period +2.0×10³% (7.2×10¹¹σ); numerics unresolved.

raw.description: **第284便b(原仮定者の裁定(第74報)⑤「f=1 の修正を進める」)で質量補正を廃した: f_A=f_B=1.0(massCalibration は law:"f-fixed-1")。質量は Hu et al. (2022) の観測基準質量そのもの(A 1.3382 M☉・B 1.2489 M☉)で、Kcs=0 の補正コアを外し、偶力の受け先をリザーバにした。** 📻(kFrame=0 — 観測安定則)の対になる DFM 版で、転写幾何は 📻 と同一(遠点分離 955.98 単位・転写質量での実ケプラー遠点速度・半径は EOS proxy 0.01175)。**まず見えるもの: kFrame=1(空間引きずり A8/E6′+測地線 1PN E12)では軌道が外へ膨らみ、観測の軌道にならない** —— 出発点の遠点が近点側になり、遠点は 9853.77 単位まで離れる。初速・位置・dragQ は比較用に移行前のまま固定してあり、観測値との差を**合わせる操作はしていない**(引きずりプロファイルの再調整は今後の便で新走行から行う)。旧台帳(一次則 f≈2)の周期・近点移動・短縮率は**履歴**であって、この本の現在の根拠ではない。実測(QA behavior.psrF1・既定 dt=0.016・同方向1周を 2 回): **同方向1周の 1周目 190031.36 秒・2周目 189819.52 秒**(観測 8834.534723278 秒の約 21.5 倍)。1周目の**実測離心率 0.82315**・最小分離 955.86 単位・最大分離 9853.77 単位。判定器(calaudit)では、第285便f(原仮定者の裁定(第75報)AN51)で f=1 の軌道長に合わせた窓(22 公転 × 1,187,696 步)を事前に宣言し、近点間周期を 188141.17 秒(dt 段・近点 23 個・門は数値未解決)と測った —— 4 値の区分は保留のまま動かない。殻スピンのドリフト 0.0%(spin=0 の全窓ビット保持・clampSN=0)・帳簿 L 残差 7.8×10⁻¹⁴・重心移動 6.6×10⁻⁴ 単位(2 周)。リザーバが持つ角運動量は最大で初期 L の 0.60%(遠点付近)。ワンタップ対照A/B: B側 kFrame=0(観測版の計算式側)— f=1 では質量が観測値そのものなので、B 側は観測版 📻 とまったく同じ軌道になる(1周目 8835.04 秒・近点 801.72 単位)。同じ観測・同じ質量で計算式だけが違うと、kFrame=1 側は軌道を保てないことが 1 操作で見える。否定対照(QA が機械固定): **coupleSink を外すと殻が ±40 飽和へ走り出す**(0.3公転で clampSN 3.2×10⁴)・**cmGauge を外すと重心が歩き出す**(0.5公転で 0.166 単位)。timeScale=300・dispMag=1000(表示専用 — 📻 と同じ規約)・トレイルで軌道を見る。

failureFirst.fail: **この較正は普遍則ではない。** ①λ=1×10¹¹ は物理係数 G/c²(λ=1)の 10¹¹ 倍で、DFM の公理からは決まらない外部オーバーレイの用量である。②同じ λ を 🎻(GW150914・Kerr の Q=χGm²/c・χ=0.7)へ入れると合体直前で η=3.7×10⁸ となり、通常の束縛連星を保てない。③同じ λ を 🪨(太陽–水星)へ入れると 1/r⁴ 項が近日点移動へ −1.5″/世紀 を足し、43″/世紀 の較正(実測一致 0.2%)を壊す。④コンパクトネス Ξ=GM/(Rc²) に単調な補正(λ_eff=λ₀(1+αΞ²) や Γ(1+βΞ))で ⚡ を見えるようにしても、Ξ_BH=0.5 > Ξ_NS≈0.16 なので BH 側が必ず先に壊れる(実測: η_BH=3.0×10¹⁰ / 3.2×10⁹)。⑤保存力のスピン–スピンはエネルギーを持ち去らないので、チャープも合体も作らない。⑥観測の近点移動はスピン–スピン以外(1PN・スピン–軌道)を含む総量であり、本サンプルはその全量を 1 つの 1/r⁴ 項へ押し込んでいる。⑦半径 11.75 km は EOS proxy であって A/B 個別の観測半径ではない。
failureFirst.pass: **それでも「作れる」ことは示せた。** 引きずり場の倍精度化(physics.framePrecision:"double" — 第247便a)で ⚡ の近点移動の数値床を外すと、未較正の値は dt→0 で 0.00945°/周 へ収束する(dt .002→.001 の変化 1.8×10⁻⁶・検出器 2 方式の差 2.7×10⁻⁷)。この収束した床の上で、質量係数を f=1.999914(一次則の不動点から −0.00141%)へわずかに下げ、スピン–スピンの用量を λ=1×10¹¹ に取ると、**近点移動 0.004732°/周が観測換算 0.004730957°/周 と +0.03% で一致**する。周期は fit していないのに近点間 8834.018 s(−0.0059%)・dt 外挿 8834.62 s(+0.0010%)に入る。つまり**現象論的な 1/r⁴ 項で二重パルサーの近点移動を作ることはできる** — できないのは、その同じ係数を BH と太陽系へ持って行くことである(上の fail 参照)。⚡ 本体(primary)はこの 2 ノブを持たない — 本サンプルは**枝**であって、⚡ の主張を置き換えない。

failureFirst.fail: THIS CALIBRATION IS NOT A UNIVERSAL LAW. (1) λ=1e11 is 1e11 times the physical coefficient G/c² (λ=1) and is not fixed by the DFM axioms — it is an external overlay dose. (2) Feeding the same λ to 🎻 (GW150914, Kerr Q=χGm²/c at χ=0.7) gives η=3.7e8 just before merger: no bound binary survives. (3) Feeding it to 🪨 (Sun–Mercury) adds −1.5 arcsec/century to the perihelion, breaking a calibration that agrees to 0.2%. (4) Making ⚡ visible through a correction that is MONOTONE in the compactness Ξ=GM/(Rc²) — λ_eff=λ₀(1+αΞ²) or Γ(1+βΞ) — always breaks the black hole first, because Ξ_BH=0.5 > Ξ_NS≈0.16 (measured: η_BH=3.0e10 and 3.2e9). (5) A conservative spin–spin force carries no energy away, so it produces neither chirp nor merger. (6) The observed periastron advance is a TOTAL that includes 1PN and spin–orbit terms; this sample pushes all of it into a single 1/r⁴ term. (7) The 11.75 km radius is an EOS proxy, not a measured radius of A or B.
failureFirst.pass: IT CAN NEVERTHELESS BE BUILT. Removing the numerical floor with physics.framePrecision:"double" (wave 247a — Float64 for the dragging-field arrays only) makes the uncalibrated periastron advance converge to 0.00945°/orbit as dt→0 (dt .002→.001 changes it by 1.8e-6; the two detectors differ by 2.7e-7). On that converged floor, lowering the mass factor slightly to f=1.999914 (−0.00141% off the linear law's fixed point) and setting the spin–spin dose to λ=1e11 lands the periastron advance at 0.004732°/orbit, within +0.03% of the observationally converted 0.004730957°/orbit. The period, which was not fitted, comes out at 8834.018 s (−0.0059%) and extrapolates to 8834.62 s (+0.0010%). So a phenomenological 1/r⁴ term CAN reproduce the double pulsar's periastron advance — what it cannot do is carry the same coefficient to black holes and to the solar system (see the failure above). ⚡ itself (the primary) has neither knob; this is a BRANCH and does not replace ⚡'s claim.

descStruct.summary: ⚡ COPIED, WITH TWO KNOBS TURNED: the coefficient λ and the mass factor f (wave 247a — report 39, "use every means including coefficient and mass corrections"). 1 unit = 10⁶ m / 10¹ s / 10²⁷ kg (the same L−T=5 relativistic-binary family as ⚡📻). Gravity (E4) and the kFrame=1 motion dragging (A8/E6′) are exactly ⚡'s; what is added is physics.spinSpin=1e11 (the static 1/r⁴ force between out-of-plane spin dipoles — a toy external overlay) and physics.framePrecision:"double" (an experimental flag that puts only the dragging-field arrays in Float64).
descStruct.observe: Measured (a 5.6-orbit window, phase fit over 5 periastra, dt=0.001): PERIASTRON ADVANCE 0.004732°/orbit, +0.03% of the converted observation 0.004730957°/orbit. The periastron-to-periastron period is 8834.018 s (−0.0059% of 8834.534723278 s) and extrapolates linearly in dt to 8834.62 s (+0.0010%). The λ=0 control (the B side of the A/B) gives +0.009449°/orbit over the same window, so the whole difference of −0.004717°/orbit is the 1/r⁴ term (matching the analytic −2π·η(p) to three digits). η=|F_SS|/|F_N| is 1.09e-5 at apoapsis (1.09e-16 at the physical coefficient λ=1).
descStruct.control: One-tap A/B: the B side sets spinSpin=0 (only the spin–spin force is switched off) and the advance returns to +0.009449°/orbit — the spin–spin contribution of −0.004717°/orbit disappears, while the total stays prograde. DO NOT CARRY THIS λ TO OTHER SYSTEMS: it gives η=3.7e8 for 🎻 and −1.5 arcsec/century for 🪨 (the pure function HP.dfmCompactMeasures evaluates all three at once).

en.name: PSR B1534+12 (DFM build) — observed masses (f=1) under kF1, the fourth double neutron star

calibrationForecast.scope: periastron-to-periastron P and the periastron advance
calibrationForecast.note: At f=1 (the observed masses) and kFrame=1 the orbit swells outward from the 2907.75-unit apoapsis (the start becomes the periastron side and the apoapsis moves out to 7650.43 units) and one same-direction revolution is about 4.96 times the observed period. The auditor measures the periastron-to-periastron period in the orbit window declared in wave 287b (AN62 — 22 revolutions × 1,126,979 steps). The old ledger's (f≈2) stage and convergence records are history and are not used as convergence material for this build.

failureFirst.fail: AT f=1 (THE OBSERVED MASSES) UNDER kFrame=1 (frame dragging A8/E6′ + the 1PN geodesic E12 — the DFM formula) THE OBSERVED ORBIT IS NOT HELD: the starting apoapsis at 2907.75 units becomes the periastron side and the apoapsis swells to 7650.43 units. One same-direction revolution is about 4.96 times the observed 36351.702644 s (1st revolution 180316.64 s) and the measured eccentricity is 0.44921 (transcribed 0.2736775). THE OBSERVED PERIOD IS NOT REPRODUCED. Waves 251–286 closed this gap with a mass correction f≈2 (the conditional linear-law calibration) and a Kcs=0 correction core; the adjudicator's ruling (77th report, AN62) moved this build to f=1 after ⚡🧮🩺 (the consequence of returning the masses to the observed values — nothing was adjusted). The old ledger's 'the advance is 2.025 times the observation and the excess is A0' was recorded on top of f≈2 and is not a current basis.
failureFirst.pass: The f=1 declaration is machine-fixed: the bodies' m equal the observed base masses (baseMass) bit for bit, there is no correction core, λ_PN=1 is explicit, and the couples go to the reservoir ledger by coupleSink=reservoir, so the shell spin (declared 0) is bit-held over the whole window (clampSN=0) and the ledger L residual closes at 5.5×10⁻¹⁴ over two revolutions. The initial positions, velocities and dragQ are kept from before the migration for comparison (NOTHING IS ADJUSTED TO THE OBSERVATIONS — the old calibrated values are not carried over). Side B (kFrame=0) with the same initial state and the same observed masses gives the observed orbit (1st revolution 36351.84 s, measured eccentricity 0.27368), so one tap shows that the difference lies in the formula.

descStruct.summary: WAVE 287b (the adjudicator's ruling, 77th report AN62 — the same procedure as ⚡ in wave 284b, 🧮 in wave 285f and 🩺 in wave 286f) WITHDREW THE MASS CORRECTION: f_A=f_B=1.0 (massCalibration law:"f-fixed-1"). The masses are the observed base masses of Stairs et al. (2002) (A 1.3330 M☉, B 1.3455 M☉ — GR-assuming conditional references); the Kcs=0 correction core is removed and the couples go to the reservoir. THE SAME GEOMETRY AND THE SAME OBSERVED INPUTS AS 📿, WITH ONLY THE FORMULA SWITCHED TO THE kFrame=1 DFM SIDE (wave 251a — the fourth frozen hold-out). The same system's 🪤 (proposal K) retired in this wave (a CF build retires together with its f=1 counterpart — AN62).
descStruct.observe: Measured (QA behavior.psrF1-1534, default dt=0.016, two same-direction revolutions): THE 1st SAME-DIRECTION REVOLUTION 180316.64 s, the 2nd 180298.40 s (about 4.96 times the observed 36351.702644 s). 1st-revolution MEASURED ECCENTRICITY 0.44921, minimum separation 2907.64 units, maximum 7650.43 units. The shell-spin drift is 0.0% (spin=0 bit-held over the whole window, clampSN=0), the ledger L residual 5.5×10⁻¹⁴ and the barycentre shift 2.0×10⁻³ units (two revolutions); the reservoir holds at most 0.30% of the initial L. In the auditor (calaudit), wave 287b (the adjudicator's ruling, 77th report AN62) declares the orbit window for this fourth f=1 build (one real revolution of 1,126,979 steps × 22 revolutions), in which the periastron-to-periastron period and the advance are measured (single-run values in docs/PHYSICS.md wave 287b). THE OBSERVED PERIOD IS NOT REPRODUCED.
descStruct.control: One-tap A/B: side B is kFrame=0 (the observation build's formula — side A carries frame dragging A8/E6′ + the 1PN geodesic E12) — at f=1 the masses are the observed ones, so side B gives the observed orbit (1st revolution 36351.84 s, measured eccentricity 0.27368). With the same observations and the same masses and only the formula changed, one tap shows that the kFrame=1 side cannot hold the orbit. PUT THIS SAMPLE BESIDE ⚡ (J0737), 🧮 (J1757) AND 🩺 (J1946): none of the four reproduces the observed period at f=1 under kFrame=1 (⚡ about 21.5 times, 🧮 about 2.16 times, 🩺 about 33.4 times, 🧶 about 4.96 times). With timeScale=1000 one observed orbit takes ~3.6 wall seconds; dispMag=1000 (display only).

failureFirst.fail: 観測版 🎐 の実測どおり、kFrame=1 は転写質量のままでは軌道を保てない(2.5公転窓で周回せず遠点が 208→1192 単位へ膨張・接触要素周期 +777%)。さらに本系では **hold-out の e が初めて ±1% に入らない**: P に合わせた較正の実測離心率は 0.080825(転写比 +1.0%)— ✴️💫⚡ で3例成立した「P の fit が e も当てる」構造は、合体直前(v/c≈0.21)の強速度域では崩れる(観測 e 自体の90%区間 0.02〜0.17 の内側ではある — 記録)。**第224便の粒子別 f でも e は戻らない**(rank-1 の実測 — 粒子別化の射程の外)。**実系の周期短縮(Peters ΔP/P≈−1.70%/公転・約4.0秒後に合体)も再現しない**: DFM の縮み(dt=0.016 で −0.542%/公転)は dt にほぼ線形の離散化仕事で、連続極限では消える(⚡ 第223便と同じ機構確定)。
failureFirst.pass: 「質量は軌道から計算式で算出される量 — 計算式が変われば質量が変わる」(原仮定者第8報)の**適用第4号**。基準状態の遠点(分離 208.24 単位・転写質量の実ケプラー遠点速度)を初期状態に取り(第224便: 新質量の重心系へ再配分)、kFrame=1(+geoPN=0 — 族の換算整合則)で基準周期 0.181818 s を再現する質量を較正すると **一次則の不動点 f_A=2.0000000・f_B=2.0000000**(第245便 A6 — 質量比=観測・fit ノブなし。χ 完全飽和域なので χ² 則との差は 11 桁目で、力学はビット不変)— 2周目 0.180240 秒(−0.87%)。DFM 質量は A 69.11 M☉・B 59.93 M☉(実在質量の主張ではない — 計算式に条件づけられた較正値。殻質量は massFrac=(f−1)/f で観測値のまま — 第224便の二層化)。**hold-out の e は +1.0% で初の不成立のまま**(±1% 収束の構造は3例まで — 粒子別 f でも戻らない〔rank-1 の実測〕・正直に記録)。**f≈2 への張り付きは χ 飽和の帰結**(旧 f 系列の単調性議論は χ-law が置き換えた — C 系列 ≤0.7% が記録)。殻 spin=0 は全窓保持(偶力は resL 記帳 — コアは質量記帳のみ)・重心は機械ゼロ(cmGauge)・帳簿 L 4.0×10⁻¹⁵。近点移動 +0.075°/周(順行 — kF1 引きずり項の帰結)。

descStruct.summary: **まず見えるもの: 実寸のブラックホール2個(半径 10.2/8.9 単位)が分離 193〜208 単位の近接軌道を高速で回り、軌道がゆっくり縮んでいく。縮み(ΔP/P=−0.542%/公転 — 規約刻み dt=0.016)は故障ではなく kF1 キックの離散化仕事で、連続極限では消える(dt/2 で −0.259 — ⚡ 第223便と同じ機構確定)。実系の合体(Peters −1.70%/公転)の再現ではない。**観測版 🎐(kFrame=0+geoPN=0 — 換算整合則)の**対になる DFM 版**(第223便 — ✴️💫⚡ と同型の適用第4号)。転写幾何は 🎐 と同一 — 遠点分離 208.2365 単位(=a(1+e)・a=1.928116×10⁶m・e=0.08)・遠点接線速度は転写質量での実ケプラー値・半径は Schwarzschild 換算 proxy(10.2186/8.8600)。そのうえで **kFrame=1(空間引きずり ON・geoPN=0 は族規約)で基準周期 0.181818 s を再現する質量を較正する。第245便 A6: 台帳は一次則 f=1+k_F(αχ_A+βχ_B) で不動点 f_A=2.0000000・f_B=2.0000000** — 比は法則導出(χ 完全飽和域で粒子別の差は実質消える)・**fit ノブは無い**→ A 68.88 M☉(1.3760×10³²kg)・B 59.74 M☉(1.1931×10³²kg)。位置・速度は基準の相対状態のまま新質量の重心系へ再配分。実在の質量の主張ではない(計算式に条件づけられた較正値)。**二層化(第224便 — bhCore の型の参照)**: コアは質量記帳のみ(massFrac=(f_i−1)/f_i で**殻質量=観測質量**・Ω=0・Kcs=0)— 偶力の受け皿は coupleSink:"reservoir" のまま(軌道ビット不変を実測)。**受け皿をコアへ移す案は実測棄却**(P 半減 0.0946 秒・e 0.158・コア Ω 57.9 — 軌道反作用が入り力学が別物になる。QA が否定対照で機械固定)。**hold-out の e は初の不成立のまま**(第223便 — 正直な記録): P に合わせた較正の実測離心率は 0.080825(転写比 +1.0% — ±1% に入らない。✴️💫⚡ で3例成立した収束構造は v/c≈0.21 の強速度域で崩れる。**粒子別 f でも戻らない — P・e に対する f_A/f_B の自由度は実質 rank-1**〔外部レビュー2件の一致した実測を追認〕。観測 e の90%区間 0.02〜0.17 の内側ではある)。**f≈2 への張り付きは χ 飽和の帰結**(旧 f 系列の単調性議論は χ-law が置き換えた — C 系列 0.9948/0.9929/0.9991/0.9956 ≤0.7% が記録)。殻 spin=0(転写すべき自転測定なし — 上限値のみ)・E6′-R 偶力は coupleSink:"reservoir" が resL へ記帳・**重心ゲージ cmGauge:"barycentric"**(第209便)で重心は機械ゼロ(3.7×10⁻⁵/3.4公転)。q=3.2552・D₀=0.006 は 🎐 の値をそのまま流用。働いているのは重力(E4)+空間引きずり(A8/E6′)— geoPN=0 なので測地線1PN は無い(換算整合則)。**petersGW オーバーレイ(第227便 — 第26報裁定GO・外部物理 opt-in・既定 OFF)**: physics.petersGW:true+fusion(門番 thermal:"tint")を宣言すると Peters(1964)円軌道束の抗力が掛かり、実系の合体を対照再現できる — 実測: 観測質量(🎐 型)4.116 s〔窓3〜5〕・DFM 質量 0.540 s〔窓0.3〜0.8・t∝1/f³ で約1/8〕。**DFM の帰結ではない**(fit しない・radE/radL へ厳密記帳 — 帳簿 L 残差 10⁻¹⁴)。
descStruct.observe: 実測(3.4公転窓・重心ゲージ込み・第245便 A6 の一次則質量 — χ² 則の質量とはビット同一): 周回時間 [0.181216, 0.180240, 0.179264] 秒 — **2周目 0.180240 秒は基準 0.181818 s の −0.87%**(fit 対象)。合わせていない側: 1周目の実測離心率 0.080825(転写 0.08 の **+1.0%** — hold-out 不成立の初例のまま・宣言)・近点 177.09 単位(=1.771×10⁶m)。軌道はロゼットで**近点移動 +0.075°/周**(順行)、周期は −0.542%/公転で縮む(規約刻み dt=0.016 — **dt/2 で −0.259・比 0.482 = 離散化仕事**。連続極限で消える・⚡ 第223便と同じ機構確定)。実系の合体(Peters 換算 ΔP/P≈−1.70%/公転)の再現ではない — **DFM は合体へ向かう周期短縮を持たない**(記録・fit しない)。**4秒窓の機械固定(第225便 — 外部レビュー2件の実測を追認)**: 実系の合体時刻(約4.0秒=約22公転)まで走らせても2体のまま・最小分離 165.4(接触半径和 19.08 の8.7倍)・fusion 無効・NaN 0 — dt/2 では最小分離はむしろ増える(規約刻みの縮みが連続極限で弱まる整合)。なお「4.0秒」は観測質量での Peters 値で、走っている DFM 質量(×f)では同式で約0.5秒(記録)。殻 spin=0 は全窓保持・帳簿 L 残差 4.0×10⁻¹⁵・粒子+リザーバ P 残差 9.0×10⁻¹⁵・重心移動 3.7×10⁻⁵ 単位/3.4公転(機械ゼロ)。NaN ゼロ・同一構成2回実行はビット同一(QA behavior.gw150914)。**第247便b の補足(履歴の明記)**: 上の petersGW 実測 4.116 s/0.540 s は **用量 a=1・従来方向(相対速度に沿う抗力)・規約刻み dt=0.016** の値である。従来方向は接触後の遅れが 1/dt で伸びるので、合体時刻そのものは刻みに収束しない(dt=0.004→0.0005 で遅れ 0.0281→0.2229 秒 — 第247便b の実測)。放射の**方向**(physics.petersDirection)と**用量**(physics.petersScale)を分けて約4秒へ較正した比較サンプルは ⏰ 側にあり、**🎻 本体はどちらのキーも宣言しない**(既定経路 1 bit 不変)。スピン–スピン λ=1 を観測質量で見る原理サンプルは ⚛️ 側にある。**周期は定義を宣言してから合否を言う**(第249便b→第250便d の裁定 I6): 同方向1周と近点間は別量で、判定は近点間、円に近い系は近点間が観測の定義に対応しないため注記にとどめる。
descStruct.control: ワンタップ対照A/B: B側 kFrame=0(観測版の計算式側)— **同じ初期状態・同じ較正質量(×1.989)**では引力が過剰になり、軌道は深い楕円へ落ち込む(実測: 近点 62.6 単位・実測離心率 0.538・1周目 0.0759 秒)。この較正は kFrame=1 専用であることの機械対照。否定対照(QA が機械固定): **cmGauge を外すと重心が歩き出す**(0.6公転で 0.09 単位)。**coupleSink をコアへ移すと力学が別物になる**(P 半減 0.0946 秒・e 0.158・コア Ω 57.9 — 第224便の受け皿裁定の機械対照。コアは質量記帳のみが正)。観測版 🎐 と本サンプルの対で「同じ基準状態・違う計算式・違う質量」が4例目の連星でも見える。timeScale=30 で1公転が実時間約0.38秒・dispMag=1(実寸)・トレイルで軌道を見る。

failureFirst.fail: As measured on the observation build 🎐, kFrame=1 cannot hold the orbit at the transcribed masses (no revolution within 2.5 orbits; the apoapsis inflates 208→1192 units, osculating period +777%). Moreover THE HOLD-OUT e MISSES ±1% FOR THE FIRST TIME: at the calibration fitted to P the measured eccentricity is 0.080825 (+1.0% of the transcription) — the structure that held on ✴️💫⚡ breaks in the strong-velocity regime just before merger (v/c≈0.21), though it stays inside the observational 90% interval 0.02–0.17 (recorded). The wave-224 per-body split does NOT recover it (rank-1, measured — outside the split's reach). AND THE REAL INSPIRAL IS NOT REPRODUCED: the DFM contraction (−0.542%/orbit at dt=0.016) is discretization work, nearly linear in dt, vanishing in the continuum limit (the same mechanism settled on ⚡ in wave 223) — while the real system merges ~4.0 s later at Peters ΔP/P≈−1.70%/orbit.
failureFirst.pass: THE FOURTH APPLICATION of the adjudicator's principle (8th report): masses are quantities COMPUTED FROM ORBITS BY A FORMULA. Taking the reference state's apoapsis (separation 208.24 units; wave 224 redistributes into the new masses' barycentric frame) and calibrating the masses so that kFrame=1 (+geoPN=0, the family's conversion-consistency rule) reproduces the reference period 0.181818 s gives the LINEAR-law fixed point f_A=2.0000000, f_B=2.0000000 (wave 245 A6 — observed mass ratio, no fitted knob; at full χ saturation it differs from the χ² law only in the 11th digit) — the 2nd revolution lands at 0.180240 s (−0.87%). The DFM masses are A 68.88 M☉ and B 59.74 M☉ — not real-mass claims but a calibration conditioned on the formula (the shell mass stays observed via massFrac=(f−1)/f — the wave-224 two-layer). THE HOLD-OUT e STILL MISSES (+1.0% — the ±1% convergence structure held for 3 binaries; the per-body split does not recover it; recorded honestly). The f≈2 pinning is the χ-saturation consequence (the law replaces the old monotonicity record; the C series ≤0.7% is the record). The shell spin=0 is held (the couple books into resL — the cores are a mass ledger only), the CM is at machine zero (cmGauge), ledger L 4.0×10⁻¹⁵. Periastron advance +0.075°/rev (prograde — the kF1 dragging term).

descStruct.summary: WHAT YOU SEE FIRST: two TRUE-SCALE black holes (radii 10.2/8.9 units) racing around a close orbit at separation 193–208 units, slowly shrinking. The contraction (ΔP/P=−0.542%/orbit at the convention step dt=0.016) is not a glitch but the kF1 kick's DISCRETIZATION WORK, vanishing in the continuum limit (−0.270 at dt/2 — the same mechanism settled on ⚡ in wave 223). It is NOT the real inspiral (Peters −1.70%/orbit). The DFM COUNTERPART of 🎐 (kFrame=0+geoPN=0 under the conversion-consistency rule) — the 4th application of the ✴️💫⚡ pattern (wave 223). Geometry identical to 🎐: apoapsis separation 208.2365 units (a=1.928116×10⁶ m, e=0.08), the real Kepler apoapsis speed, Schwarzschild-equivalent proxy radii (10.2186/8.8600). The masses are calibrated so kFrame=1 (geoPN=0 is the family convention) reproduces the reference period 0.181818 s — wave 245 A6: the LINEAR-law fixed point f_A=2.0000000, f_B=2.0000000 (law-derived ratio — effectively common at χ saturation; there is no fitted knob; the retired share-era normalisation was f=1+A, zero-fit 0.44%) → A 68.88 M☉ (1.3760×10³² kg), B 59.74 M☉ (1.1931×10³² kg), redistributed into the new masses' barycentric frame — NOT real-mass claims (conditioned on the formula). THE TWO-LAYER (wave 224 — referencing bhCore's pattern): the cores are a MASS LEDGER ONLY (massFrac=(f_i−1)/f_i so the SHELL MASS = THE OBSERVED MASS; Ω=0, Kcs=0) — the couple's receptacle stays coupleSink:"reservoir" (measured orbit-bit-invariant). MOVING THE SINK TO THE CORES IS REJECTED BY MEASUREMENT (P halves to 0.0959 s, e 0.154, core Ω 57.9 — an orbital reaction enters and the dynamics change entirely; machine-fixed by QA as a negative control). THE HOLD-OUT e STILL MISSES (wave 223 — recorded honestly): the measured eccentricity is 0.080825 (+1.0% — outside ±1%; the convergence structure that held on ✴️💫⚡ breaks at v/c≈0.21. THE PER-BODY SPLIT DOES NOT RECOVER IT — f_A/f_B is effectively rank-1 against P and e 〔confirming both external reviews' measurements〕; inside the observational 90% interval 0.02–0.17).
